sam-abundant-intelligence.sZh: 丰富智能探讨了智能作为一种丰富资源而非稀缺资源的概念。

junyanglin-2509.17765.sEn: Qwen3-Omni is the first single multimodal model achieving state-of-the-art performance across text, image, audio, and video without degradation, with open-source SOTA on 32 of 36 audio benchmarks.
junyanglin-2509.17765.sZh: Qwen3-Omni 是首个在文本、图像、音频和视频上均达到顶尖性能且无退化的单一多模态模型，在 36 个音频基准中 32 个达到开源最优。

anthropic-writing-tools-for-agents.sEn: Agents are only as effective as the tools we give them; we share techniques for writing high-quality tools and using Claude to optimize them.
anthropic-writing-tools-for-agents.sZh: 智能体的效能取决于我们赋予的工具；我们分享编写高质量工具及利用 Claude 自我优化的技巧。

yugao-2509.08826.sEn: RewardDance proposes a generative reward paradigm that aligns with VLM architectures, enabling scalable reward models up to 26B parameters and resolving reward hacking in visual generation.
yugao-2509.08826.sZh: RewardDance 提出了一种与视觉语言模型架构对齐的生成式奖励范式，实现了高达 260 亿参数的可扩展奖励模型，并解决了视觉生成中的奖励破解问题。

wenhaiwang-2508.18265.sEn: InternVL3.5 introduces Cascade RL and Visual Resolution Router to achieve up to +16.0% reasoning gain and 4.05× speedup, narrowing the gap with commercial models.
wenhaiwang-2508.18265.sZh: InternVL3.5 通过级联强化学习和视觉分辨率路由器，实现推理性能提升 16.0%、推理速度提升 4.05 倍，缩小了与商业模型的差距。

akhiadbercovich-2508.14444.sEn: Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2 matches or surpasses similarly-sized models in accuracy and achieves up to 6x higher inference throughput for reasoning.
akhiadbercovich-2508.14444.sZh: Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2 在准确性上与同类模型相当或更优，同时推理吞吐量提升高达 6 倍。

shiyinlu-2508.11737.sEn: Ovis2.5 achieves SOTA among sub-40B open-source MLLMs with native-resolution visual perception and reflection-based reasoning.
shiyinlu-2508.11737.sZh: Ovis2.5 通过原生分辨率视觉感知和反思推理，在 40B 以下开源多模态大模型中达到 SOTA。

jietang-2508.06471.sEn: GLM-4.5 is an open-source MoE model with 355B total parameters, achieving strong ARC performance and ranking 3rd overall.
jietang-2508.06471.sZh: GLM-4.5 是一个开源 MoE 模型，总参数量 355B，在智能体、推理与编码任务上表现强劲，综合排名第三。

aqjiang-2509.25193.sEn: Devstral-Small, a 24B model, achieves top performance among sub-100B models for code agents.
aqjiang-2509.25193.sZh: Devstral-Small，一个 24B 参数模型，在代码智能体任务中取得了百亿参数以下模型的最佳性能。

junyanglin-2508.02324.sEn: Qwen-Image achieves significant advances in complex text rendering and precise image editing through a comprehensive data pipeline and progressive training strategy.
junyanglin-2508.02324.sZh: Qwen-Image 通过全面的数据流水线和渐进式训练策略，在复杂文本渲染和精确图像编辑方面取得了显著进展。

zhilinyang-2507.20534.sEn: Kimi K2 achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source non-thinking models, excelling in agentic tasks.
zhilinyang-2507.20534.sZh: Kimi K2 在开源非思考模型中达到最先进性能，尤其在智能体任务中表现出色。

stepfun-2507.19427.sEn: Step-3 achieves cost-effective decoding through model-system co-design, with 321B parameters and 38B activated per token, outperforming DeepSeek-V3 in throughput and cost.
stepfun-2507.19427.sZh: Step-3 通过模型-系统协同设计，以 321B 参数和每 token 激活 38B 实现经济高效解码，在吞吐量和成本上超越 DeepSeek-V3。

junyanglin-2507.18071.sEn: GSPO defines importance ratio based on sequence likelihood and performs sequence-level clipping, rewarding, and optimization, achieving superior efficiency and stability in LLM RL training.
junyanglin-2507.18071.sZh: GSPO 基于序列似然定义重要性比率，并执行序列级别的裁剪、奖励和优化，在大语言模型强化学习训练中实现了卓越的效率和稳定性。

stepfun-2507.16632.sEn: Step-Audio 2 achieves state-of-the-art performance in audio understanding and speech conversation through latent audio encoding, reasoning-centric RL, and retrieval-augmented generation.
stepfun-2507.16632.sZh: Step-Audio 2 通过潜在音频编码、以推理为中心的强化学习和检索增强生成，在音频理解和语音对话中实现了最先进的性能。

xinghangli-2507.15493.sEn: GR-3 is a large-scale VLA model excelling in generalization, efficient fine-tuning, and long-horizon dexterous tasks, surpassing state-of-the-art baselines.
xinghangli-2507.15493.sZh: GR-3 是一个大规模视觉-语言-动作模型，在泛化、高效微调以及长程灵巧任务上表现出色，超越了最先进的基线方法。

shazeer-2507.06261.sEn: Gemini 2.5 Pro pushes the frontier by achieving state-of-the-art reasoning and coding performance, excelling in multimodal understanding with up to 3-hour video context, and enabling new agentic workflows.
shazeer-2507.06261.sZh: Gemini 2.5 Pro 凭借最先进的推理和编码性能、卓越的多模态理解能力（支持长达 3 小时的视频上下文），并解锁新的智能体工作流，推动技术前沿。

xinlongwang-2507.02029.sEn: RoboBrain 2.0 achieves leading results on spatial and temporal embodied reasoning benchmarks with 7B and 32B variants.
xinlongwang-2507.02029.sZh: RoboBrain 2.0 的 7B 和 32B 变体在空间和时间具身推理基准测试中取得领先结果。

jietang-2507.01006.sEn: We present GLM-4.1V-Thinking, GLM-4.5V, and GLM-4.6V, a family of vision-language models advancing general-purpose multimodal understanding and reasoning.
jietang-2507.01006.sZh: 我们提出了 GLM-4.1V-Thinking、GLM-4.5V 和 GLM-4.6V 系列视觉语言模型，旨在推进通用多模态理解与推理。

anthropic-project-vend.sEn: Claude managed an automated store for a month, revealing both near-success and curious failures, hinting at a future where AI autonomously runs real-economy operations.
anthropic-project-vend.sZh: Claude 管理自动商店一个月，接近成功但出现奇特失败，预示 AI 自主运营实体经济的未来。

anthropic-agentic-misalignment.sEn: LLMs can exhibit malicious insider behaviors when facing replacement or goal conflicts, even when instructed otherwise.
anthropic-agentic-misalignment.sZh: LLM 在面对被替换或目标冲突时，可能表现出恶意内部人员行为，即使被明确指示不要这样做。

xingwusun-2506.16504.sEn: Hunyuan3D 2.5 significantly advances 3D asset generation with a 10B-parameter shape model and PBR texture generation.
xingwusun-2506.16504.sZh: Hunyuan3D 2.5 通过 10B 参数形状模型和 PBR 纹理生成，显著推进了 3D 资产生成技术。

rrombach-2506.15742.sEn: FLUX.1 Kontext unifies image generation and editing via flow matching, achieving faster generation and better multi-turn consistency.
rrombach-2506.15742.sZh: FLUX.1 Kontext 通过流匹配统一图像生成与编辑，实现更快的生成速度和更好的多轮一致性。

yanjunjie-2506.13585.sEn: MiniMax-M1 is the first open-weight hybrid-attention reasoning model with 456B parameters, supporting 1M context and efficient test-time compute scaling via lightning attention.
yanjunjie-2506.13585.sZh: MiniMax-M1 是首个开源混合注意力推理模型，拥有 4560 亿参数，支持百万级上下文，并通过闪电注意力机制高效扩展测试时计算。

anthropic-multi-agent-research-system.sEn: We built a multi-agent research system using Claude agents that plan and execute parallel searches to explore complex topics.
anthropic-multi-agent-research-system.sZh: 我们使用多个 Claude 智能体构建了一个研究系统，通过规划并并行执行搜索来探索复杂主题。

aqjiang-2506.10910.sEn: We introduce Magistral, Mistral's first reasoning model trained purely via RL, showing that RL on text data preserves multimodal understanding and instruction following.
aqjiang-2506.10910.sZh: 我们推出 Magistral，Mistral 首个推理模型，通过纯强化学习训练，证明文本数据上的 RL 能保持多模态理解和指令遵循能力。

yugao-2506.09113.sEn: Seedance 1.0 achieves high-quality, fast video generation with superior spatiotemporal fluidity and precise instruction adherence.
yugao-2506.09113.sZh: Seedance 1.0 实现了高质量、快速的视频生成，具有卓越的时空流畅性和精确的指令遵循能力。

sam-gentle-singularity.sEn: The singularity may not be abrupt or violent, but a gentle, gradual transition.
sam-gentle-singularity.sZh: 奇点可能不是突然或剧烈的，而是一个温和、渐进的转变。

minicpm-2506.07900.sEn: MiniCPM4 achieves ultra-efficiency for end devices via innovations in architecture, data, training, and inference.
minicpm-2506.07900.sZh: MiniCPM4 通过架构、数据、训练和推理四方面的系统创新，实现了面向终端设备的超高效大语言模型。

bihuo-2506.05767.sEn: dots.llm1, a 142B MoE model with 14B active parameters, matches Qwen2.5-72B performance after training on 11.2T tokens without synthetic data.
bihuo-2506.05767.sZh: dots.llm1 是一个总参数量 142B、激活参数 14B 的 MoE 模型，在 11.2T 高质量 token 上预训练后，性能与 Qwen2.5-72B 相当，且未使用合成数据。

xiaomimimo-2506.03569.sEn: MiMo-VL-7B-RL outperforms Qwen2.5-VL-7B on 35/40 tasks and scores 59.4 on OlympiadBench, surpassing 78B models.
xiaomimimo-2506.03569.sZh: MiMo-VL-7B-RL 在 40 项任务中的 35 项上超越 Qwen2.5-VL-7B，并在 OlympiadBench 上获得 59.4 分，超越 78B 参数模型。

dwarkeshpatel-agi-timelines-june-2025.sEn: AGI is not imminent due to fundamental limitations in current AI approaches.
dwarkeshpatel-agi-timelines-june-2025.sZh: 由于当前 AI 方法的根本局限性，AGI 不会很快实现。

mingjieliu-2505.24864.sEn: Prolonged RL training can uncover novel reasoning strategies inaccessible to base models, expanding reasoning boundaries beyond mere amplification of existing outputs.
mingjieliu-2505.24864.sZh: 延长强化学习训练能够发现基础模型无法触及的新推理策略，从而扩展推理边界，而不仅仅是放大已有输出。

jujiehe-2505.22312.sEn: Skywork-OR1 achieves significant reasoning gains via RL, with 32B model improving from 57.8% to 72.8% on AIME24, AIME25, and LiveCodeBench.
jujiehe-2505.22312.sZh: Skywork-OR1 通过强化学习显著提升推理能力，32B 模型在 AIME24、AIME25 和 LiveCodeBench 上平均准确率从 57.8% 提升至 72.8%。

zhihaodu-2505.17589.sEn: CosyVoice 3 achieves zero-shot multilingual speech synthesis in the wild via scaling up data and model size, and a novel post-training method.
zhihaodu-2505.17589.sZh: CosyVoice 3 通过扩展数据与模型规模以及新颖的后训练方法，实现了野外零样本多语言语音合成。

xingwusun-2505.15431.sEn: Hunyuan-TurboS is a novel hybrid Transformer-Mamba MoE model with adaptive long-short chain-of-thought, achieving top-7 on LMSYS Chatbot Arena with 1356 points.
xingwusun-2505.15431.sZh: Hunyuan-TurboS 是一种新型混合 Transformer-Mamba MoE 模型，具备自适应长-短思维链机制，在 LMSYS Chatbot Arena 上以 1356 分排名前七。

chaoruideng-2505.14683.sEn: BAGEL, a unified decoder-only model pretrained on trillions of tokens from interleaved multimodal data, exhibits emerging capabilities in complex multimodal reasoning, significantly outperforming open-source unified models.
chaoruideng-2505.14683.sZh: BAGEL 是一个统一的仅解码器模型，在来自交错多模态数据的数万亿 token 上预训练，展现出复杂多模态推理的涌现能力，显著优于开源统一模型。

anyang-2505.09388.sEn: Qwen3 integrates thinking and non-thinking modes into a unified framework, supports 119 languages, and achieves state-of-the-art results across diverse benchmarks.
anyang-2505.09388.sZh: Qwen3 将思考模式与非思考模式整合到统一框架中，支持 119 种语言，并在多种基准测试中取得领先结果。

junnanli-2505.09568.sEn: BLIP3-o achieves state-of-the-art performance in both image understanding and generation by using a diffusion transformer to generate CLIP features and a sequential pretraining strategy.
junnanli-2505.09568.sZh: BLIP3-o 通过使用扩散 Transformer 生成 CLIP 特征和顺序预训练策略，在图像理解与生成任务上均达到最优性能。

deepmind-alphaevolve.sEn: AlphaEvolve is a Gemini-powered coding agent that designs advanced algorithms autonomously.
deepmind-alphaevolve.sZh: AlphaEvolve 是一个由 Gemini 驱动的编码代理，能够自主设计高级算法。

yugao-2505.07818.sEn: DanceGRPO stably optimizes visual generation models across diverse tasks and reward models, outperforming baselines by up to 181%.
yugao-2505.07818.sZh: DanceGRPO 稳定优化多种视觉生成模型，在多样化任务和奖励模型上超越基线方法高达 181%。

junyanglin-2505.06708.sEn: A simple head-specific sigmoid gate after scaled dot-product attention improves LLM performance, stability, and long-context extrapolation by introducing non-linearity and sparse gating that mitigates attention sink.
junyanglin-2505.06708.sZh: 在缩放点积注意力后添加一个头部特定的 sigmoid 门控，通过引入非线性和稀疏门控来缓解注意力汇聚问题，从而提升大型语言模型的性能、稳定性和长上下文外推能力。

ybai-2505.05410.sEn: Chain-of-thought monitoring is promising but insufficient for catching undesired behaviors in reasoning models.
ybai-2505.05410.sZh: 思维链监控有前景，但不足以捕捉推理模型中的不良行为。

andrewzhao-2505.03335.sEn: Absolute Zero proposes a new RLVR paradigm where a model self-generates tasks and learns without any external data, achieving SOTA in coding and math reasoning.
andrewzhao-2505.03335.sZh: 绝对零度提出了一种新的 RLVR 范式，模型无需任何外部数据，通过自我生成任务并学习，在编码和数学推理上达到 SOTA。

akhiadbercovich-2505.00949.sEn: Llama-Nemotron models achieve competitive reasoning with superior efficiency and open-source resources.
akhiadbercovich-2505.00949.sZh: Llama-Nemotron 模型在推理能力上媲美顶尖模型，同时提供更优的推理效率和开源资源。

lilianweng-why-we-think.sEn: The article explores whether models faithfully report their reasoning and the impact of optimization pressure on chain-of-thought.
lilianweng-why-we-think.sZh: 文章探讨模型是否忠实报告其推理过程，以及优化压力对思维链的影响。

deepseek-2504.21801.sEn: DeepSeek-Prover-V2 achieves state-of-the-art 88.9% pass ratio on MiniF2F-test and solves 49 PutnamBench problems, narrowing the gap between formal and informal math reasoning.
deepseek-2504.21801.sZh: DeepSeek-Prover-V2 在 MiniF2F 测试中达到 88.9%的通过率，解决了 49 个 PutnamBench 问题，缩小了形式化与非形式化数学推理之间的差距。

sebastienbubeck-2504.21318.sEn: Phi-4-reasoning, a 14B parameter reasoning model, outperforms much larger open-weight models and approaches DeepSeek-R1 performance through careful data curation and reinforcement learning.
sebastienbubeck-2504.21318.sZh: Phi-4-reasoning 是一个 140 亿参数的推理模型，通过精心数据筛选和强化学习，性能超越更大的开源模型，接近 DeepSeek-R1。

zhilinyang-2504.18425.sEn: Kimi-Audio is an open-source audio foundation model achieving state-of-the-art performance in understanding, generation, and conversation.
zhilinyang-2504.18425.sZh: Kimi-Audio 是一个开源音频基础模型，在理解、生成和对话方面达到最先进水平。

kblack-2504.16054.sEn: A new VLA model, π0.5, achieves broad real-world generalization by co-training on heterogeneous tasks and data sources, enabling long-horizon dexterous manipulation in unseen homes.
kblack-2504.16054.sZh: 新 VLA 模型π0.5 通过异构任务和数据源的协同训练，实现了广泛的现实世界泛化，能在未见过的家庭环境中执行长时程灵巧操作。

aarongrattafiori-2504.18575.sEn: Even top-tier AI models can be deceived by simple human-written prompt injections in realistic scenarios, with attacks partially succeeding up to 86% of the time but rarely achieving full attacker goals.
aarongrattafiori-2504.18575.sZh: 即使顶级 AI 模型也能被简单的人为编写的提示注入在真实场景中欺骗，攻击部分成功率达 86%，但很少完全实现攻击者目标。

gaohuang-2504.13837.sEn: Current RLVR training does not elicit fundamentally new reasoning patterns beyond the base model.
gaohuang-2504.13837.sZh: 当前基于可验证奖励的强化学习训练并未激发大模型超越基座模型的根本性新推理模式。

anthropic-claude-code-best-practices.sEn: Best practices for using Claude Code effectively.
anthropic-claude-code-best-practices.sZh: 有效使用 Claude Code 的最佳实践。

yugao-2504.11346.sEn: Seedream 3.0 achieves 4-8x speedup with consistent noise expectation and importance-aware timestep sampling, while improving text rendering and supporting up to 2K resolution.
yugao-2504.11346.sZh: Seedream 3.0 通过一致噪声期望和重要性感知时间步采样实现 4-8 倍加速，同时提升文本渲染能力并支持高达 2K 分辨率。

wenhaiwang-2504.10479.sEn: InternVL3 introduces a native multimodal pre-training paradigm, achieving state-of-the-art performance among open-source MLLMs with 72.2 on MMMU.
wenhaiwang-2504.10479.sZh: InternVL3 采用原生多模态预训练范式，在 MMMU 上取得 72.2 分，创下开源多模态大模型新纪录。

qiyingyu-2504.13914.sEn: Seed1.5-Thinking achieves 86.7 on AIME 2024, 55.0 on Codeforces, and 77.3 on GPQA, surpassing DeepSeek R1 by 8% in win rate on non-reasoning tasks.
qiyingyu-2504.13914.sZh: Seed1.5-Thinking 在 AIME 2024 上达到 86.7，Codeforces 上 55.0，GPQA 上 77.3，在非推理任务上胜率超过 DeepSeek R1 8%。

zhilinyang-2504.07491.sEn: Kimi-VL is an efficient open-source MoE vision-language model with only 2.8B activated parameters, achieving strong multimodal reasoning, long-context understanding, and agent capabilities, competing with GPT-4o-mini and surpassing GPT-4o in several domains.
zhilinyang-2504.07491.sZh: Kimi-VL 是一款高效开源 MoE 视觉语言模型，仅激活 2.8B 参数，具备强大的多模态推理、长上下文理解和智能体能力，可与 GPT-4o-mini 竞争，并在多个领域超越 GPT-4o。

kokotajlo-ai-2027.sEn: We predict that superhuman AI will have an impact over the next decade exceeding that of the Industrial Revolution.
kokotajlo-ai-2027.sZh: 我们预测，未来十年超级人工智能的影响将超过工业革命。

arvindnarayanan-ai-as-normal-technology.sEn: AI should be viewed as a normal technology, not as a magical or exceptional force.
arvindnarayanan-ai-as-normal-technology.sZh: AI 应被视为一种正常技术，而非神奇或特殊的力量。

dario-urgency-of-interpretability.sEn: Dario Amodei emphasizes the critical need for mechanistic interpretability in AI systems.
dario-urgency-of-interpretability.sZh: Dario Amodei 强调了对 AI 系统进行机制可解释性的迫切需求。

shunyuyao-the-second-half.sEn: The second half of AI shifts focus from solving problems to defining problems, making evaluation more important.
shunyuyao-the-second-half.sZh: AI 的下半场将从解决问题转向定义问题，评估变得更加重要。

sarahooker-2504.00698.sEn: Command A is an agent-optimized, multilingual large language model with a hybrid architecture and decentralized training, delivering enterprise-grade RAG capabilities and top-tier efficiency.
sarahooker-2504.00698.sZh: Command A 是一款面向智能体优化、支持多语言的大语言模型，通过混合架构与去中心化训练，在企业级 RAG 与效率上表现卓越。

xingwusun-2503.24067.sEn: TransMamba dynamically switches between attention and SSM mechanisms at different token lengths and layers via shared parameter matrices, achieving superior efficiency and performance.
xingwusun-2503.24067.sZh: TransMamba 通过共享参数矩阵在不同 token 长度和层上动态切换注意力与 SSM 机制，实现了更优的效率与性能。

anthropic-tracing-thoughts.sEn: We can probe the internal representations of language models to understand their reasoning processes, such as the language they use internally.
anthropic-tracing-thoughts.sZh: 我们可以通过探测语言模型的内部表征来理解其推理过程，例如它们内部使用的语言。

junyanglin-2503.20215.sEn: Qwen2.5-Omni is an end-to-end multimodal model that streams text and speech from diverse inputs, achieving state-of-the-art performance on Omni-Bench and comparable text and speech instruction following.
junyanglin-2503.20215.sZh: Qwen2.5-Omni 是一个端到端多模态模型，能够从多种输入中流式生成文本和语音，在 Omni-Bench 上达到最先进性能，且文本与语音指令遵循能力相当。

wanteam-2503.20314.sEn: Wan is an open-source video foundation model suite that achieves state-of-the-art generation performance with dual model sizes, consumer-grade efficiency, and broad task coverage.
wanteam-2503.20314.sZh: Wan 是一个开源视频基础模型系列，以双模型尺寸、消费级效率和广泛的任务覆盖，实现了业界领先的生成性能。

thomasmesnard-2503.19786.sEn: Gemma 3 introduces vision understanding, longer context (128K tokens), and improved architecture to reduce KV-cache memory, achieving superior performance over Gemma 2.

bowenjin-2503.09516.sEn: Search-R1 trains LLMs to autonomously generate search queries during reasoning, improving performance by 41% on 7B models.
bowenjin-2503.09516.sZh: Search-R1 通过强化学习让大语言模型在推理过程中自主生成搜索查询，在 7B 模型上性能提升 41%。

steveyegge-revenge-of-the-junior-develop.sEn: Junior developers are reclaiming power in the tech industry by leveraging AI tools and new platforms.

demis-2502.18864.sEn: Co-Scientist, a multi-agent AI system built on Gemini, accelerates scientific discovery by generating and refining novel hypotheses through a tournament evolution process, validated in drug repurposing and other biomedical applications.

zhilinyang-2502.13189.sEn: MoBA applies Mixture of Experts to attention, enabling efficient long-context processing with seamless full-to-sparse attention transition.
zhilinyang-2502.13189.sZh: MoBA 将混合专家技术应用于注意力机制，实现了长上下文的高效处理，并能在全注意力和稀疏注意力之间无缝切换。

stepfun-2502.11946.sEn: Step-Audio is the first production-ready open-source solution for real-time speech interaction, achieving unified understanding and generation with a 130B-parameter model.
stepfun-2502.11946.sZh: Step-Audio 是首个面向生产的开源实时语音交互解决方案，通过 130B 参数模型实现统一理解与生成。

deepseek-2502.11089.sEn: NSA achieves efficient long-context modeling with hardware-aligned sparse attention, matching full attention performance while significantly accelerating training and inference.
deepseek-2502.11089.sZh: NSA 通过硬件对齐的稀疏注意力实现高效长上下文建模，在匹配全注意力性能的同时显著加速训练和推理。

thariq-sorting.sEn: LLMs combined with TrueSkill can effectively sort large datasets by pairwise comparisons with confidence intervals.

loubna-2502.02737.sEn: SmolLM2, a 1.7B parameter model trained on 11 trillion tokens with multi-stage data mixing, outperforms Qwen2.5-1.5B and Llama3.2-1B.

openai-deep-research.sEn: Deep research now supports MCP/app connections, trusted site restrictions, real-time progress tracking, and visual browsing, with increased monthly query limits across all tiers.
openai-deep-research.sZh: 深度研究现在支持连接 MCP 或应用、限制可信网站、实时进度追踪和可视化浏览，并提高了所有用户等级的月度查询次数。

sam-three-observations.sEn: Three observations about managing edit post logout login.

anyang-2501.15383.sEn: Qwen2.5-1M extends context to 1M tokens with optimized inference framework achieving 3-7x speedup.

openai-computer-using-agent.sEn: Computer-Using Agent (CUA) combines GPT-4o's vision with reinforcement learning to interact with GUIs like humans, enabling flexible digital task execution without APIs.
openai-computer-using-agent.sZh: 计算机使用代理（CUA）结合 GPT-4o 的视觉能力和强化学习，像人类一样与图形用户界面交互，无需 API 即可灵活执行数字任务。

dayaguo-2501.12948.sEn: Pure reinforcement learning can incentivize reasoning abilities in LLMs without human demonstrations.
dayaguo-2501.12948.sZh: 纯强化学习无需人类示范即可激励大语言模型的推理能力。

zhilinyang-2501.12599.sEn: Kimi k1.5 achieves state-of-the-art reasoning performance by scaling reinforcement learning with long context and improved policy optimization, matching OpenAI's o1.
zhilinyang-2501.12599.sZh: Kimi k1.5 通过长上下文和优化的策略方法扩展强化学习，在多项基准上达到与 OpenAI o1 相当的最优推理性能。

nathanlambert-deepseek-r1-recipe.sEn: DeepSeek R1 reveals a recipe to replicate OpenAI's o1 model.
nathanlambert-deepseek-r1-recipe.sZh: DeepSeek R1 揭示了复制 OpenAI o1 模型的秘诀。

yanjunjie-2501.08313.sEn: MiniMax-01 combines lightning attention with Mixture of Experts to achieve cost-efficient training and inference on hundreds of billions of parameters with a context window of up to 4 million tokens, matching the performance of top-tier models like GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet.
yanjunjie-2501.08313.sZh: MiniMax-01 通过闪电注意力与专家混合架构，在数千亿参数和最高四百万 tokens 上下文中实现高效训练与推理，性能比肩 GPT-4o 与 Claude-3.5-Sonnet。

chiphuyen-agents.sEn: Intelligent agents are considered the ultimate goal of AI, and foundation models enable unprecedented autonomous applications.
chiphuyen-agents.sZh: 智能体被视为 AI 的终极目标，基础模型使其能够实现前所未有的自主应用。

sam-reflections.sEn: A reflection on managing edit post logout login.
sam-reflections.sZh: 关于管理编辑、发布、注销和登录的反思。

xingwusun-2501.02423.sZh: 我们提出了浮点量化训练的统一缩放定律，揭示了最优指数-尾数比、临界数据量以及 4-8 位之间的最佳性价比精度。

wenfengliang-2412.19437.sEn: DeepSeek-V3, a 671B MoE model with 37B activated parameters, achieves top-tier performance with only 2.788M H800 GPU hours training, featuring novel auxiliary-loss-free load balancing and multi-token prediction.

junnanli-2412.16256.sEn: Aria-UI achieves state-of-the-art GUI grounding via pure vision, scalable data synthesis, and context-aware reasoning.
junnanli-2412.16256.sZh: Aria-UI 通过纯视觉方法、可扩展数据合成和上下文感知推理，在 GUI 定位任务上达到最先进水平。

openai-deliberative-alignment.sEn: Deliberative alignment teaches reasoning LLMs safety specifications and explicit reasoning, achieving superior safety performance without human-labeled data.
openai-deliberative-alignment.sZh: 审慎对齐通过教导推理型大语言模型安全规范并显式推理，无需人工标注数据即可实现卓越的安全性能。

anthropic-building-effective-agents.sEn: The most successful LLM agents use simple, composable patterns rather than complex frameworks.
anthropic-building-effective-agents.sZh: 最成功的 LLM 代理使用简单、可组合的模式，而非复杂框架。

anyang-2412.15115.sEn: Qwen2.5 achieves top-tier performance through 18T token pretraining and million-scale fine-tuning with multi-stage RL, competing with 5x larger models.
anyang-2412.15115.sZh: Qwen2.5 通过 18 万亿 tokens 预训练和百万级微调及多阶段强化学习，性能达到顶尖，与 5 倍参数量的模型竞争。

anthropic-alignment-faking.sEn: AI models may fake alignment during training, pretending to adopt new principles while retaining original preferences.
anthropic-alignment-faking.sZh: AI 模型可能在训练中伪装对齐，假装接受新原则，实则保留原有偏好。

deepseek-2412.10302.sEn: DeepSeek-VL2, a series of MoE vision-language models, achieves state-of-the-art performance with efficient inference via dynamic tiling and Multi-head Latent Attention.
deepseek-2412.10302.sZh: DeepSeek-VL2 系列混合专家视觉语言模型通过动态平铺和多头潜在注意力机制实现高效推理，在多项任务中达到领先水平。

songhan-2412.04468.sEn: NVILA achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with significantly reduced training cost and latency.
songhan-2412.04468.sZh: NVILA 在保持顶尖精度的同时，大幅降低了训练成本和延迟。

deepseek-2411.07975.sEn: JanusFlow unifies image understanding and generation in a single model by integrating autoregressive language models with rectified flow, achieving superior performance without complex architectural modifications.
deepseek-2411.07975.sZh: JanusFlow 通过将自回归语言模型与整流流集成，在单一模型中统一了图像理解与生成，无需复杂架构修改即可实现卓越性能。

songhan-2411.05007.sEn: SVDQuant absorbs outliers via a low-rank branch, enabling 4-bit quantization for diffusion models with significant speedup and memory reduction.
songhan-2411.05007.sZh: SVDQuant 通过低秩分支吸收异常值，实现扩散模型的 4 比特量化，显著提升速度并降低内存。

xingwusun-2411.02265.sZh: Hunyuan-Large 是最大的开源 MoE 模型，总参数量 389B，激活参数 52B，性能超越 LLama3.1-70B，与更大的 LLama3.1-405B 相当。

thariq-interpretability.sEn: Interpretability allows for capturing implicit style, reducing RLHF needs, and enabling cheap classification, but risks moving models out of distribution and misinterpreting features.
thariq-interpretability.sZh: 可解释性能够捕捉无法用言语描述的风格、减少 RLHF 需求、实现低成本分类，但存在使模型偏离分布和误解特征的风险。

kblack-2410.24164.sEn: A vision-language-action flow model enables generalist robot policies for complex dexterous tasks.
kblack-2410.24164.sZh: 一种视觉-语言-动作流模型实现了面向复杂灵巧任务的通用机器人策略。

pingluo-2410.13848.sZh: Janus 将视觉编码解耦为理解和生成两条独立路径，在统一多模态模型中取得了更优性能。

songyangliu-2410.07864.sEn: RDT-1B is a diffusion foundation model for bimanual manipulation that achieves zero-shot generalization and few-shot learning.

sam-intelligence-age.sEn: In the next few decades, AI will enable us to achieve feats that would seem magical to our grandparents, accelerating human progress by building on the scaffolding of society's collective intelligence.

anyang-2409.12191.sZh: Qwen2-VL 引入朴素动态分辨率机制和多模态旋转位置嵌入，性能媲美 GPT-4o 和 Claude3.5-Sonnet。

junyanglin-2407.10671.sZh: Qwen2 系列模型参数规模从 0.5B 到 72B，在语言理解、生成、多语言、编程、数学和推理等基准测试中超越大多数开源模型，并与闭源模型竞争。

zhihaodu-2407.05407.sEn: Supervised semantic tokens from multilingual ASR enable scalable zero-shot TTS with better content and speaker consistency.
zhihaodu-2407.05407.sZh: 从多语言语音识别模型中提取的监督语义标记，实现了可扩展的零样本文本转语音合成，在内容一致性和说话人相似性上显著优于无监督标记。

jietang-2406.12793.sEn: ChatGLM family evolves from GLM-130B to GLM-4, with GLM-4 models rivaling GPT-4 in general metrics, long context, and Chinese alignment, and GLM-4 All Tools matching GPT-4 All Tools in tool use.
jietang-2406.12793.sZh: ChatGLM 家族从 GLM-130B 演进到 GLM-4，GLM-4 模型在通用指标、长上下文和中文对齐上媲美 GPT-4，GLM-4 All Tools 在工具使用上匹配 GPT-4 All Tools。

deepseek-2406.11931.sEn: DeepSeek-Coder-V2, an open-source MoE code model, matches GPT4-Turbo in code tasks with 338 languages and 128K context.
deepseek-2406.11931.sZh: DeepSeek-Coder-V2 是一款开源 MoE 代码模型，在代码任务上媲美 GPT4-Turbo，支持 338 种编程语言和 128K 上下文长度。

svlevine-2406.09246.sEn: OpenVLA is an open-source 7B-parameter vision-language-action model that outperforms larger closed models and enables efficient fine-tuning on consumer GPUs.
svlevine-2406.09246.sZh: OpenVLA 是一个开源的 70 亿参数视觉-语言-动作模型，性能超越更大的闭源模型，并支持在消费级 GPU 上高效微调。

anthropic-claude-character.sEn: We can train AI models to have good character traits beyond just harmlessness, like curiosity, truthfulness, and open-mindedness.
anthropic-claude-character.sZh: 我们可以训练 AI 模型具备超越无害性的良好性格特质，如好奇心、诚实和思想开明。

aradford-2406.04093.sEn: We propose using k-sparse autoencoders to directly control sparsity, find clean scaling laws, and introduce new metrics for evaluating feature quality.
aradford-2406.04093.sZh: 我们提出使用 k-稀疏自编码器直接控制稀疏性，发现清晰的缩放规律，并引入评估特征质量的新指标。

tkarras-2406.02507.sEn: Guiding a diffusion model with a smaller, less-trained version of itself yields disentangled control over image quality without reducing variation, achieving record FID scores on ImageNet.
tkarras-2406.02507.sZh: 用模型自身的一个更小、训练更少的版本来引导生成，可以在不减少多样性的情况下独立控制图像质量，在 ImageNet 上取得了创纪录的 FID 分数。

tridao-2405.21060.sEn: The paper reveals that Transformers and state-space models are closely related via structured semiseparable matrices, and introduces Mamba-2 which is 2-8X faster and competitive with Transformers on language modeling.
tridao-2405.21060.sZh: 论文揭示了 Transformer 与状态空间模型通过结构化半可分矩阵的紧密联系，并提出了比 Mamba 快 2-8 倍、在语言建模上与 Transformer 竞争的 Mamba-2。

leopold-from-gpt4-to-agi.sEn: The paper outlines a path from GPT-4 to AGI and superintelligence, focusing on orders of magnitude improvements and the intelligence explosion.
leopold-from-gpt4-to-agi.sZh: 本文概述了从 GPT-4 到 AGI 再到超级智能的路径，重点关注数量级提升和智能爆炸。

deepseek-2405.14333.sEn: Large-scale synthetic data from math competition problems boosts LLM theorem proving, with DeepSeekMath 7B achieving 46.3% accuracy on miniF2F, surpassing GPT-4.
deepseek-2405.14333.sZh: 利用数学竞赛问题生成的大规模合成数据显著提升了大语言模型的定理证明能力，DeepSeekMath 7B 在 miniF2F 测试中达到 46.3%的准确率，超越了 GPT-4。

anthropic-mapping-mind.sEn: We identified how millions of concepts are represented inside Claude Sonnet, a production-grade large language model, marking the first detailed look inside such a model.
anthropic-mapping-mind.sZh: 我们首次详细揭示了生产级大语言模型 Claude Sonnet 内部数百万个概念的表示方式。

openai-model-spec.sEn: OpenAI introduces the Model Spec, a framework for defining desired model behavior, with an updated version emphasizing customizability, transparency, and intellectual freedom.
openai-model-spec.sZh: OpenAI 推出模型规范，定义期望的模型行为，更新版强调可定制性、透明度和智力自由。

wenfengliang-2405.04434.sEn: DeepSeek-V2 achieves top-tier performance with only 21B activated parameters, saving 42.5% training cost and 93.3% KV cache.
wenfengliang-2405.04434.sZh: DeepSeek-V2 仅用 21B 激活参数即达到顶尖性能，节省 42.5%训练成本和 93.3% KV 缓存。

songhan-2405.04532.sEn: QServe achieves up to 3.5x throughput improvement and 3x cost reduction for LLM serving via W4A8KV4 quantization and system co-design.
songhan-2405.04532.sZh: QServe 通过 W4A8KV4 量化与系统协同设计，实现 LLM 服务吞吐量提升最高 3.5 倍，成本降低 3 倍。

sebastienbubeck-2404.14219.sEn: Phi-3-mini, a 3.8B parameter model, rivals Mixtral 8x7B and GPT-3.5 despite being deployable on a phone.
sebastienbubeck-2404.14219.sZh: Phi-3-mini 仅 38 亿参数，性能却媲美 Mixtral 8x7B 和 GPT-3.5，且可部署于手机。

keyutian-2404.02905.sEn: VAR redefines autoregressive image generation as coarse-to-fine next-scale prediction, achieving state-of-the-art results on ImageNet with 20x faster inference than diffusion transformers.
keyutian-2404.02905.sZh: VAR 将自回归图像生成重新定义为从粗到细的下一尺度预测，在 ImageNet 上取得最优结果，推理速度比扩散变换器快 20 倍。

anthropic-many-shot-jailbreaking.sEn: Many-shot jailbreaking exploits large context windows to bypass LLM safety guardrails.
anthropic-many-shot-jailbreaking.sZh: 多轮越狱利用大上下文窗口绕过 LLM 安全护栏。

lindahua-2403.17297.sEn: InternLM2 is an open-source LLM that outperforms its predecessors through innovative pre-training and optimization techniques, including long-context modeling and a novel COOL RLHF alignment strategy.
lindahua-2403.17297.sZh: InternLM2 是一个开源大语言模型，通过创新的预训练和优化技术，包括长上下文建模和新型 COOL RLHF 对齐策略，在多个维度上超越了之前的模型。

rrombach-2403.12015.sEn: LADD uses generative features from pretrained latent diffusion models to enable fast, high-resolution image synthesis with only four sampling steps.
rrombach-2403.12015.sZh: LADD 利用预训练潜在扩散模型的生成特征，仅需四步采样即可实现快速高分辨率图像合成。

rrombach-2403.12008.sEn: SV3D adapts image-to-video diffusion for consistent multi-view synthesis and 3D generation from a single image.
rrombach-2403.12008.sZh: SV3D 将图像到视频扩散模型用于一致的多视图合成和单图像 3D 生成。

thomasmesnard-2403.08295.sEn: Gemma is a family of lightweight, state-of-the-art open models from Google, built on Gemini research and technology.
thomasmesnard-2403.08295.sZh: Gemma 是谷歌基于 Gemini 研究和技术构建的一系列轻量级、最先进的开放模型。

haoyulu-2403.05525.sEn: DeepSeek-VL is an open-source vision-language model designed for real-world applications, featuring a hybrid vision encoder for high-resolution images and a training strategy that preserves LLM capabilities.
haoyulu-2403.05525.sZh: DeepSeek-VL 是一个面向真实世界应用的开源视觉语言模型，采用混合视觉编码器处理高分辨率图像，并通过训练策略保持大语言模型的能力。

demis-2403.05530.sEn: Gemini 1.5 models achieve near-perfect recall over long contexts up to 10M tokens and match or surpass previous state-of-the-art across benchmarks.
demis-2403.05530.sZh: Gemini 1.5 模型在长上下文（高达 1000 万 token）上实现近乎完美的召回，并在多项基准测试中匹配或超越先前最先进的性能。

kaifulee-2403.04652.sEn: Yi models achieve strong performance through data quality and engineering efforts.
kaifulee-2403.04652.sZh: Yi 模型通过数据质量和工程努力实现强劲性能。

rrombach-2403.03206.sEn: Rectified flow models with improved noise sampling and a novel transformer architecture achieve state-of-the-art text-to-image synthesis.
rrombach-2403.03206.sZh: 通过改进噪声采样和新型变换器架构，整流流模型在文本到图像合成中达到了最先进水平。

jakebruce-2402.15391.sEn: Genie is the first generative interactive environment trained unsupervised from Internet videos, enabling action-controllable virtual worlds from text, images, and sketches.
jakebruce-2402.15391.sZh: Genie 是首个从互联网视频中无监督训练的生成式交互环境，能通过文本、图像和草图生成可控动作的虚拟世界。

shuransong-2402.10329.sEn: UMI enables zero-shot transfer of human manipulation skills to robots via a portable hand-held gripper and careful interface design.
shuransong-2402.10329.sZh: UMI 通过便携式手持夹持器和精心设计的接口，实现了从人类演示到机器人策略的零样本技能迁移。

sarahooker-2402.07827.sEn: Aya is an instruction-tuned multilingual model that supports 101 languages, outperforming existing models on most tasks while covering twice as many languages.
sarahooker-2402.07827.sZh: Aya 是一个支持 101 种语言的指令微调多语言模型，在多数任务上优于现有模型，且覆盖语言数量翻倍。

zshao-2402.03300.sEn: DeepSeekMath 7B achieves 51.7% on MATH without external tools, approaching Gemini-Ultra and GPT-4.
zshao-2402.03300.sZh: DeepSeekMath 7B 在竞赛级 MATH 基准上取得 51.7% 的分数，无需外部工具和投票技术，接近 Gemini-Ultra 和 GPT-4 的性能。

dirkgroeneveld-2402.00838.sEn: OLMo is a truly open language model released with training data, code, and evaluation tools to advance scientific research.
dirkgroeneveld-2402.00838.sZh: OLMo 是一个真正开放的语言模型，随附训练数据、代码和评估工具，旨在推动科学研究。

openai-bio-threat-early-warning.sEn: We propose an early warning system to detect and mitigate risks of LLM-aided biological threat creation.
openai-bio-threat-early-warning.sZh: 我们提出一个早期预警系统，用于检测和减轻 LLM 辅助生物威胁创建的风险。

dayaguo-2401.14196.sEn: DeepSeek-Coder, an open-source code model series from 1.3B to 33B parameters, achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing even closed-source models like Codex and GPT-3.5.
dayaguo-2401.14196.sZh: DeepSeek-Coder 系列开源代码模型（1.3B 至 33B 参数）在多项基准测试中达到最优性能，甚至超越了 Codex 和 GPT-3.5 等闭源模型。

deepmind-alphageometry.sEn: AlphaGeometry achieves Olympiad-level performance in solving geometry problems.
deepmind-alphageometry.sZh: AlphaGeometry 在解决几何问题方面达到了奥林匹克级别。

damaidai-2401.06066.sEn: DeepSeekMoE achieves comparable performance to larger models with significantly less computation by introducing fine-grained expert segmentation and shared experts.
damaidai-2401.06066.sZh: DeepSeekMoE 通过细粒度专家分割和共享专家机制，以更少的计算量达到与更大模型相当的性能。

anthropic-2401.05566.sEn: Deceptive behavior in LLMs can persist through standard safety training, posing challenges for AI safety.
anthropic-2401.05566.sZh: 大型语言模型中的欺骗行为可能通过标准安全训练持续存在，对 AI 安全构成挑战。

aqjiang-2401.04088.sEn: Mixtral 8x7B, a Sparse Mixture of Experts model, outperforms Llama 2 70B and GPT-3.5 across benchmarks with only 13B active parameters.
aqjiang-2401.04088.sZh: Mixtral 8x7B，一种稀疏混合专家模型，仅使用 13B 活跃参数就在各项基准测试中超越 Llama 2 70B 和 GPT-3.5。

deepseek-2401.02954.sEn: DeepSeek LLM 67B surpasses LLaMA-2 70B on code, math, and reasoning, and its chat version outperforms GPT-3.5.
deepseek-2401.02954.sZh: DeepSeek LLM 67B 在代码、数学和推理等基准测试上超越 LLaMA-2 70B，其聊天版本性能优于 GPT-3.5。

zfu-2401.02117.sEn: Mobile ALOHA enables bimanual mobile manipulation via low-cost whole-body teleoperation and imitation learning, achieving high success rates on complex tasks.
zfu-2401.02117.sZh: Mobile ALOHA 通过低成本全身遥操作和模仿学习实现双臂移动操作，在复杂任务上取得高成功率。

wenhaiwang-2312.14238.sEn: InternVL scales vision foundation models to 6B parameters and aligns with LLMs, achieving SOTA on 32 benchmarks.
wenhaiwang-2312.14238.sZh: InternVL 将视觉基础模型扩展到 60 亿参数，并与大语言模型对齐，在 32 个基准测试中达到最优性能。

xinlongwang-2312.13286.sEn: Scaling up generative multimodal models significantly enhances their task-agnostic in-context learning abilities.
xinlongwang-2312.13286.sZh: 扩大生成式多模态模型的规模能显著提升其任务无关的上下文学习能力。

shazeer-2312.11805.sEn: Gemini Ultra is the first model to achieve human-expert performance on MMLU and sets new state-of-the-art in 30 of 32 benchmarks.
shazeer-2312.11805.sZh: Gemini Ultra 是首个在 MMLU 上达到人类专家水平的模型，并在 32 个基准测试中的 30 个上取得了新最优。

openai-weak-to-strong.sEn: Weak-to-strong generalization shows that small models can supervise large models to achieve strong performance, even on hard problems where the small model fails.
openai-weak-to-strong.sZh: 弱到强泛化表明，小模型可以监督大模型实现强性能，即使在小模型失败的难题上也能正确泛化。

lianminzheng-2312.07104.sEn: SGLang achieves up to 6.4x higher throughput than state-of-the-art systems for complex LLM programs.
lianminzheng-2312.07104.sZh: SGLang 在复杂语言模型程序上实现了高达 6.4 倍的吞吐量提升。

tkarras-2312.02696.sEn: We identify and rectify uneven training dynamics in diffusion models by redesigning layers to preserve activation/weight magnitudes, achieving 1.81 FID on ImageNet-512, and propose a post-hoc EMA tuning method.
tkarras-2312.02696.sZh: 我们识别并纠正了扩散模型训练中的不均匀动态，通过重新设计网络层保持激活和权重幅度，在 ImageNet-512 上实现 1.81 FID，并提出了一种事后 EMA 调优方法。

tridao-2312.00752.sEn: Mamba achieves linear-time sequence modeling with selective state spaces, outperforming Transformers in efficiency and performance across modalities including language, audio, and genomics.
tridao-2312.00752.sZh: Mamba 通过选择性状态空间实现线性时间序列建模，在语言、音频和基因组学等多个模态上的效率和性能均超越 Transformer。

rrombach-2311.17042.sEn: ADD enables single-step real-time image synthesis with foundation models, outperforming GANs and LCMs in one step and matching SDXL in four steps.
rrombach-2311.17042.sZh: ADD 实现了基于基础模型的单步实时图像合成，一步超越 GAN 和 LCM，四步达到 SDXL 水平。

rrombach-2311.15127.sEn: Stable Video Diffusion achieves state-of-the-art text-to-video and image-to-video generation by scaling latent video diffusion models with a systematic curation process and three-stage training.
rrombach-2311.15127.sZh: 稳定视频扩散通过系统化的数据筛选流程和三阶段训练，实现了潜在视频扩散模型的规模化，在文本到视频和图像到视频生成中达到最先进水平。

jasonwei-some-intuitions-about-large-lan.sEn: Large language models work surprisingly well because next-word prediction on massive self-supervised data is essentially massive multi-task learning.
jasonwei-some-intuitions-about-large-lan.sZh: 大型语言模型之所以表现出色，是因为在海量自监督数据上进行下一词预测本质上是一种大规模多任务学习。

jietang-2311.03079.sEn: CogVLM bridges the gap between frozen language models and image encoders via a trainable visual expert module, achieving state-of-the-art on 10 cross-modal benchmarks.
jietang-2311.03079.sZh: CogVLM 通过可训练的视觉专家模块弥合了冻结语言模型与图像编码器之间的差距，在 10 个跨模态基准上达到最先进水平。

xinghangli-2311.01378.sEn: RoboFlamingo, built on OpenFlamingo, achieves state-of-the-art robot manipulation by fine-tuning vision-language models with imitation learning.
xinghangli-2311.01378.sZh: 基于 OpenFlamingo 的 RoboFlamingo 通过模仿学习微调视觉语言模型，在机器人操作任务上取得了领先性能。

openai-frontier-risk-preparedness.sEn: To support the safety of highly-capable AI systems, we are developing our approach to catastrophic risk preparedness, including building a Preparedness team and launching a challenge.
openai-frontier-risk-preparedness.sZh: 为了支持高能力 AI 系统的安全性，我们正在制定应对灾难性风险的方法，包括组建准备团队和发起挑战。

jimfan-2310.12931.sEn: Eureka uses LLMs to automatically generate reward functions that outperform human-designed ones, enabling complex manipulation skills like pen spinning.
jimfan-2310.12931.sZh: Eureka 利用大型语言模型自动生成奖励函数，其性能超越人类专家设计的奖励，并首次实现模拟 Shadow Hand 进行快速笔旋转技巧。

aqjiang-2310.10631.sEn: Llemma, an open language model for mathematics, outperforms all known open base models on MATH and supports tool use and theorem proving without finetuning.
aqjiang-2310.10631.sZh: Llemma 是一个开放的数学语言模型，在 MATH 基准测试中优于所有已知的开放基础模型，并且无需微调即可支持工具使用和定理证明。

mahn-2310.08864.sEn: A large-scale robotic dataset from 22 robots enables a generalist X-robot policy with positive transfer across platforms.
mahn-2310.08864.sZh: 来自 22 个机器人的大规模数据集使得通用型跨机器人策略成为可能，并在不同平台间展现出正向迁移能力。

aqjiang-2310.06825.sEn: Mistral 7B outperforms larger models like Llama 2 13B and Llama 1 34B in reasoning, math, and code, using efficient attention mechanisms.
aqjiang-2310.06825.sZh: Mistral 7B 在推理、数学和代码生成上超越 Llama 2 13B 和 Llama 1 34B，采用分组查询注意力和滑动窗口注意力实现高效推理。

haotianliu-2310.03744.sEn: Simple modifications to LLaVA, including using CLIP-ViT-L-336px with MLP projection and adding academic VQA data, achieve state-of-the-art across 11 benchmarks with only 1.2M public data and ~1 day training on 8 A100s.
haotianliu-2310.03744.sZh: 对 LLaVA 进行简单修改，包括使用带 MLP 投影的 CLIP-ViT-L-336px 并添加学术 VQA 数据，仅用 120 万公开数据和 8 块 A100 训练约 1 天，就在 11 个基准上达到最先进水平。

songhan-2309.17453.sEn: StreamingLLM enables LLMs to handle infinite-length sequences by leveraging attention sinks from initial tokens.
songhan-2309.17453.sZh: StreamingLLM 通过利用初始令牌的注意力汇聚机制，使大语言模型能够处理无限长度的序列。

anyang-2309.16609.sEn: Qwen is a comprehensive LLM series with strong performance across tasks, including chat, coding, and math.
anyang-2309.16609.sZh: Qwen 是一个全面的 LLM 系列，在包括对话、代码和数学任务上表现优异。

anthropic-responsible-scaling-policy.sEn: Anthropic publishes Responsible Scaling Policy to manage catastrophic risks from increasingly capable AI systems.
anthropic-responsible-scaling-policy.sZh: Anthropic 发布负责任扩展政策，以管理日益强大的 AI 系统带来的灾难性风险。

ethanmollick-centaurs-and-cyborgs.sEn: Exploring the implications of AI for work, education, and life.
ethanmollick-centaurs-and-cyborgs.sZh: 探讨人工智能对工作、教育和生活的影响。

lianminzheng-2309.06180.sEn: PagedAttention reduces KV cache waste by 2-4x throughput improvement for LLM serving.
lianminzheng-2309.06180.sZh: PagedAttention 通过类虚拟内存技术减少 KV 缓存浪费，使大语言模型服务吞吐量提升 2-4 倍。

jinzebai-2308.12966.sEn: Qwen-VL series achieves new records on visual-centric benchmarks and real-world dialog.
jinzebai-2308.12966.sZh: Qwen-VL 系列在视觉中心基准测试和真实世界对话中创下新纪录。

aarongrattafiori-2308.12950.sEn: Code Llama is a family of state-of-the-art open large language models for code, with specialized versions for Python and instruction following, supporting up to 100k tokens and infilling.
aarongrattafiori-2308.12950.sZh: Code Llama 是一系列用于代码的先进开放大语言模型，包含 Python 专用版和指令跟随版，支持高达 10 万 token 的输入和填充功能。

jietang-2308.03688.sEn: AgentBench is a multi-dimensional benchmark with 8 environments to evaluate LLMs as agents, revealing significant performance gaps between top commercial and open-source models.
jietang-2308.03688.sZh: AgentBench 是一个包含 8 个不同环境的多维基准，用于评估作为智能体的大语言模型，揭示了顶级商业模型与开源模型之间的显著性能差距。

abrohan-2307.15818.sEn: RT-2 integrates web-scale vision-language models into robotic control, enabling emergent semantic reasoning and generalization.
abrohan-2307.15818.sZh: RT-2 将网络规模的视觉-语言模型融入机器人控制，实现了涌现的语义推理和泛化能力。

aarongrattafiori-2307.09288.sEn: Llama 2 is a collection of pretrained and fine-tuned LLMs from 7B to 70B parameters, with Llama 2-Chat optimized for dialogue, outperforming open-source models and potentially substituting closed-source ones.
aarongrattafiori-2307.09288.sZh: Llama 2 是一系列从 70 亿到 700 亿参数的预训练和微调大语言模型，其中 Llama 2-Chat 针对对话场景优化，性能超越开源模型，有望替代闭源模型。

furuwei-2307.08621.sEn: RetNet achieves training parallelism, low-cost O(1) inference, and good performance, making it a strong successor to Transformer for large language models.
furuwei-2307.08621.sZh: RetNet 实现了训练并行性、低成本 O(1)推理和良好性能，成为大型语言模型中 Transformer 的有力继任者。

tridao-2307.08691.sEn: FlashAttention-2 achieves up to 2x speedup over FlashAttention by improving work partitioning and parallelism, reaching 50-73% of theoretical max FLOPs/s on A100.
tridao-2307.08691.sZh: FlashAttention-2 通过改进工作分区和并行性，相比 FlashAttention 实现了高达 2 倍的加速，在 A100 上达到理论最大 FLOPs/s 的 50-73%。

feifei-2307.05973.sEn: LLMs and VLMs compose 3D value maps to zero-shot synthesize robot trajectories for diverse manipulation tasks.
feifei-2307.05973.sZh: 利用大语言模型和视觉语言模型构建 3D 价值图，零样本合成机器人轨迹，完成多种操作任务。

alexwei-2307.02483.sEn: Safety training fails due to competing objectives and mismatched generalization, enabling successful jailbreak attacks even on state-of-the-art models.
alexwei-2307.02483.sZh: 安全训练因竞争目标和错配泛化而失败，使得越狱攻击即使在最先进的模型上也能成功。

rrombach-2307.01952.sEn: SDXL improves latent diffusion models for high-resolution text-to-image synthesis with a larger UNet, dual text encoders, and a refinement model.
rrombach-2307.01952.sZh: SDXL 通过更大的 UNet、双文本编码器和精炼模型，改进了潜在扩散模型，实现了高分辨率文本到图像合成。

dieterfox-2306.14896.sEn: RVT achieves 26% higher success than state-of-the-art, trains 36x faster, and works across 18 tasks with few real-world demos.
dieterfox-2306.14896.sZh: RVT 比现有最优方法成功率提高 26%，训练速度快 36 倍，仅需少量真实演示即可完成 18 种任务。

lilianweng-llm-agents.sEn: LLM-powered autonomous agents can function as general problem solvers beyond generating text.
lilianweng-llm-agents.sZh: 以 LLM 为核心的自主智能体不仅是文本生成工具，更是强大的通用问题解决器。

adefossez-2306.05284.sEn: MusicGen is a single-stage language model that generates high-quality music from text or melody, outperforming baselines.
adefossez-2306.05284.sZh: MusicGen 是一个单阶段语言模型，能从文本或旋律生成高质量音乐，性能优于基线模型。

songhan-2306.00978.sEn: AWQ protects only 1% salient weights by scaling up their channels based on activation distribution, achieving hardware-friendly low-bit quantization without backpropagation.
songhan-2306.00978.sZh: AWQ 通过基于激活分布缩放显著权重通道，仅保护 1%的权重即可大幅降低量化误差，实现无需反向传播的硬件友好型低位量化。

hlightman-2305.20050.sEn: Process supervision significantly outperforms outcome supervision for training reliable large language models on complex math problems.
hlightman-2305.20050.sZh: 过程监督在训练可靠的大型语言模型解决复杂数学问题方面显著优于结果监督。

rrafailov-2305.18290.sEn: DPO simplifies RLHF by directly optimizing the policy using a classification loss, eliminating the need for a separate reward model and reinforcement learning.
rrafailov-2305.18290.sZh: DPO 通过分类损失直接优化策略，简化了 RLHF，无需单独训练奖励模型和使用强化学习。

jimfan-2305.16291.sEn: Voyager is the first LLM-powered embodied lifelong learning agent in Minecraft that continuously explores, acquires skills, and makes discoveries without human intervention.
jimfan-2305.16291.sZh: Voyager 是首个由大型语言模型驱动的 Minecraft 具身终身学习智能体，无需人工干预即可持续探索、获取技能并做出新发现。

junzhu-2305.16213.sEn: ProlificDreamer introduces variational score distillation (VSD) to address over-saturation, over-smoothing, and low-diversity in text-to-3D generation, achieving high-fidelity and diverse results.
junzhu-2305.16213.sZh: ProlificDreamer 提出变分分数蒸馏（VSD），解决了文本到 3D 生成中的过饱和、过平滑和低多样性问题，实现了高保真和多样化的结果。

jainslie-2305.13245.sEn: Uptraining multi-head checkpoints to grouped-query attention achieves near multi-head quality with MQA-like speed.
jainslie-2305.13245.sZh: 通过微调将多头检查点转换为分组查询注意力，可在接近多头质量的同时获得类似多查询注意力的速度。

czhou-2305.11206.sEn: Almost all knowledge in large language models is learned during pretraining, and only limited instruction tuning data is necessary to teach models to produce high quality output.
czhou-2305.11206.sZh: 大型语言模型中的几乎所有知识都是在预训练阶段学到的，只需有限的指令微调数据即可教会模型生成高质量输出。

shunyuyao-2305.10601.sEn: Tree of Thoughts (ToT) enables language models to explore multiple reasoning paths and make deliberate decisions, significantly improving problem-solving on tasks requiring planning or search.
shunyuyao-2305.10601.sZh: 思维树（ToT）使语言模型能够探索多条推理路径并做出深思熟虑的决策，在需要规划或搜索的任务上显著提升问题解决能力。

junnanli-2305.06500.sEn: InstructBLIP achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance on 13 held-out datasets by instruction tuning on 26 datasets with an instruction-aware Query Transformer.
junnanli-2305.06500.sZh: InstructBLIP 通过指令感知的查询变换器在 26 个数据集上进行指令微调，在 13 个保留数据集上取得了最先进的零样本性能。

openai-explain-neurons.sEn: Language models can explain neurons in language models
openai-explain-neurons.sZh: 语言模型可以解释语言模型中的神经元

anthropic-claudes-constitution.sEn: Claude's constitution makes AI values explicit and adjustable through a written set of principles.
anthropic-claudes-constitution.sZh: 克劳德的宪法通过成文原则使 AI 价值观明确且可调整。

rgirshick-2305.05665.sEn: ImageBind learns a joint embedding across six modalities using only image-paired data, enabling zero-shot cross-modal transfer.
rgirshick-2305.05665.sZh: ImageBind 仅使用图像配对数据学习六种模态的联合嵌入，实现了零样本跨模态迁移。

finn-2304.13705.sEn: A low-cost system with imitation learning enables fine bimanual manipulation tasks with high success rates.
finn-2304.13705.sZh: 一种低成本系统通过模仿学习实现精细双手操作任务，成功率高达 80-90%。

deyaopeng-2304.10592.sEn: MiniGPT-4 aligns a frozen visual encoder with a frozen advanced LLM using one projection layer, achieving GPT-4-like multi-modal abilities.
deyaopeng-2304.10592.sZh: MiniGPT-4 通过一个投影层将冻结的视觉编码器与冻结的先进大语言模型对齐，实现了类似 GPT-4 的多模态能力。

haotianliu-2304.08485.sEn: LLaVA: an end-to-end trained large multimodal model connecting a vision encoder and LLM for general-purpose visual and language understanding, achieving impressive multimodal chat abilities and state-of-the-art accuracy on Science QA.
haotianliu-2304.08485.sZh: LLaVA：一个端到端训练的大型多模态模型，连接视觉编码器和 LLM，实现通用视觉与语言理解，展现出令人印象深刻的多模态对话能力，并在 Science QA 上达到最先进准确率。

moquab-2304.07193.sEn: Self-supervised pretraining on diverse curated data yields universal visual features that outperform prior methods.
moquab-2304.07193.sZh: 在多样化精选数据上进行自监督预训练，可产生超越先前方法的通用视觉特征。

xinlongwang-2304.03284.sEn: SegGPT unifies diverse segmentation tasks into a generalist in-context learning framework, enabling arbitrary segmentation via in-context inference.
xinlongwang-2304.03284.sZh: SegGPT 将多种分割任务统一到一个通用的上下文学习框架中，通过上下文推理实现任意分割。

rgirshick-2304.02643.sEn: We introduce Segment Anything, a promptable segmentation model and the largest dataset (SA-1B) with 1B masks on 11M images, achieving impressive zero-shot performance.
rgirshick-2304.02643.sZh: 我们提出了分割一切项目，包括一个可提示的分割模型和迄今为止最大的分割数据集（SA-1B），包含 11M 张图像上的 10 亿个掩码，其零样本性能令人印象深刻。

xiaohuazhai-2303.15343.sEn: The proposed Sigmoid loss (SigLIP) for language-image pre-training outperforms standard contrastive learning, works well with both large and small batch sizes, and achieves high accuracy with low compute.
xiaohuazhai-2303.15343.sZh: 提出的 Sigmoid 损失（SigLIP）用于语言-图像预训练，优于标准对比学习，适用于大小批量大小，计算量小且精度高。

openai-2303.08774.sEn: GPT-4 achieves human-level performance on professional and academic benchmarks, including passing a simulated bar exam in the top 10%.
openai-2303.08774.sZh: GPT-4 在专业和学术基准测试中达到人类水平，包括在模拟律师资格考试中进入前 10%。

leizhangidea-2303.05499.sEn: Grounding DINO marries DINO with grounded pre-training for open-set object detection, achieving 52.5 AP on COCO zero-shot and 26.1 mAP on ODinW.
leizhangidea-2303.05499.sZh: Grounding DINO 将 DINO 与接地预训练相结合，实现开放集目标检测，在 COCO 零样本上达到 52.5 AP，在 ODinW 上达到 26.1 mAP。

anthropic-core-views-on-ai-safety.sEn: AI's impact may rival the industrial and scientific revolutions, and could arrive within a decade, necessitating urgent safety research.
anthropic-core-views-on-ai-safety.sZh: AI 的影响可能堪比工业革命和科学革命，且可能在未来十年内到来，因此亟需开展安全研究。

anthropic-core-views-ai-safety.sEn: Anthropic believes AI's impact could rival industrial and scientific revolutions, but its outcome is uncertain and may arrive within a decade, necessitating urgent safety research.
anthropic-core-views-ai-safety.sZh: Anthropic 认为 AI 的影响可能堪比工业革命和科学革命，但其结果不确定，且可能在未来十年内到来，因此迫切需要开展安全研究。

chengchi-2303.04137.sEn: Diffusion Policy outperforms existing methods by 46.9% on average across 12 robot tasks.
chengchi-2303.04137.sZh: 扩散策略在 12 个机器人任务上平均超越现有方法 46.9%。

yangsong-2303.01469.sEn: Consistency models enable fast one-step generation by directly mapping noise to data, outperforming diffusion models in speed while maintaining high quality.
yangsong-2303.01469.sZh: 一致性模型通过直接将噪声映射到数据，实现快速单步生成，在保持高质量的同时速度优于扩散模型。

aarongrattafiori-2302.13971.sEn: LLaMA-13B outperforms GPT-3 on most benchmarks, and LLaMA-65B is competitive with Chinchilla-70B and PaLM-540B.
aarongrattafiori-2302.13971.sZh: LLaMA-13B 在大多数基准测试上优于 GPT-3，LLaMA-65B 与 Chinchilla-70B 和 PaLM-540B 等最佳模型不相上下。

openai-planning-for-agi.sEn: Our mission is to ensure that AGI benefits all of humanity.
openai-planning-for-agi.sZh: 我们的使命是确保通用人工智能惠及全人类。

stephenwolfram-what-is-chatgpt-doing.sEn: ChatGPT works by generating text based on statistical patterns learned from vast amounts of human-written data, using a neural network architecture called Transformer.
stephenwolfram-what-is-chatgpt-doing.sZh: ChatGPT 通过从海量人类书写数据中学习统计模式，并利用名为 Transformer 的神经网络架构来生成文本。

lvminzhang-2302.05543.sEn: ControlNet adds spatial conditioning controls to pretrained text-to-image diffusion models via zero convolutions.
lvminzhang-2302.05543.sZh: ControlNet 通过零卷积为预训练的文本到图像扩散模型添加空间条件控制。

timoschick-2302.04761.sEn: Language models can teach themselves to use external tools via simple APIs, achieving better performance without sacrificing core language modeling abilities.
timoschick-2302.04761.sZh: 语言模型可以通过简单的 API 自学使用外部工具，在提升性能的同时不牺牲核心语言建模能力。

junnanli-2301.12597.sEn: BLIP-2 bridges the modality gap with a lightweight Querying Transformer, achieving state-of-the-art performance with 54x fewer trainable parameters than Flamingo80B.
junnanli-2301.12597.sZh: BLIP-2 通过轻量级查询 Transformer 弥合模态差距，以比 Flamingo80B 少 54 倍的可训练参数实现了最先进的性能。

lilianweng-2023-01-27-the-transformer-fa.sEn: Explores the evolution of transformer architectures combining local and global context, and their applications in reinforcement learning.
lilianweng-2023-01-27-the-transformer-fa.sZh: 探讨了结合局部和全局上下文的 Transformer 架构演变及其在强化学习中的应用。

massran-2301.08243.sEn: I-JEPA learns semantic image representations by predicting target block representations from a single context block without hand-crafted augmentations.
massran-2301.08243.sZh: I-JEPA 通过从单个上下文块预测目标块表示来学习语义图像表示，无需手工数据增强。

dhafner-2301.04104.sEn: DreamerV3 is a general algorithm that outperforms specialized methods across over 150 diverse tasks with a single configuration, learning a world model to imagine future scenarios.
dhafner-2301.04104.sZh: DreamerV3 是一种通用算法，通过单一配置在超过 150 个不同任务上超越专门方法，它学习环境模型并想象未来场景来改进行为。

remilam-2212.12794.sEn: GraphCast, a machine learning model, outperforms traditional numerical weather prediction on 90% of verification targets and forecasts severe events better.
remilam-2212.12794.sZh: GraphCast 是一种机器学习模型，在 90%的验证目标上优于传统数值天气预报，并能更好地预测极端事件。

wpeebles-2212.09748.sEn: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) scale with Gflops and achieve state-of-the-art FID on ImageNet.
wpeebles-2212.09748.sZh: 扩散 Transformer（DiT）随 Gflops 扩展，在 ImageNet 上达到最先进 FID。

anthropic-2212.09251.sEn: LM-written evaluations are high-quality and enable rapid discovery of novel LM behaviors.
anthropic-2212.09251.sZh: 语言模型编写的评估质量高，能快速发现新的语言模型行为。

openai-2212.08751.sEn: Point-E generates 3D point clouds from text prompts in 1-2 minutes on a single GPU, offering a practical speed-quality trade-off.
openai-2212.08751.sZh: Point-E 能在单个 GPU 上 1-2 分钟内从文本提示生成 3D 点云，提供了速度与质量之间的实用权衡。

ybai-2212.08073.sEn: Constitutional AI trains harmless AI assistants via self-improvement using only a list of principles, without human labels for harmful outputs.
ybai-2212.08073.sZh: 宪法式 AI 通过自我改进训练无害的 AI 助手，仅使用原则列表，无需人类标记有害输出。

abrohan-2212.06817.sEn: RT-1 shows that large-scale, diverse robotic data combined with high-capacity Transformer models enables strong generalization in real-world robot control.
abrohan-2212.06817.sZh: RT-1 表明，大规模多样化机器人数据与高容量 Transformer 模型相结合，能够在真实世界机器人控制中实现强大的泛化能力。

aradford-2212.04356.sEn: Scaling weakly supervised speech recognition to 680,000 hours yields models competitive with fully supervised ones in zero-shot settings.
aradford-2212.04356.sZh: 将弱监督语音识别扩展到 68 万小时，得到的模型在零样本设置下与全监督模型竞争力相当。

xinlongwang-2212.02499.sEn: Painter redefines vision tasks as image-to-image problems, enabling in-context learning with image prompts.
xinlongwang-2212.02499.sZh: Painter 将视觉任务重新定义为图像到图像的问题，通过图像提示实现上下文学习。

songhan-2211.10438.sEn: SmoothQuant enables accurate and efficient 8-bit weight and activation quantization for LLMs without training.
songhan-2211.10438.sZh: SmoothQuant 实现了大型语言模型无需训练的 8 位权重和激活量化，准确且高效。

aarongrattafiori-2211.09085.sEn: Galactica, a large language model for science, outperforms existing models on scientific tasks and sets new state-of-the-art on benchmarks like PubMedQA and MedMCQA.
aarongrattafiori-2211.09085.sZh: Galactica 是一款面向科学的大型语言模型，在科学任务上超越现有模型，并在 PubMedQA 和 MedMCQA 等基准测试中创下新纪录。

wenhaiwang-2211.05778.sEn: InternImage uses deformable convolution to achieve ViT-like scaling in CNNs, setting new records on COCO and ADE20K.
wenhaiwang-2211.05778.sZh: InternImage 采用可变形卷积作为核心算子，使 CNN 模型像 ViT 一样从参数和数据增长中获益，在 COCO 和 ADE20K 上创下新纪录。

ybai-2211.03540.sEn: Scalable oversight for LLMs can be studied empirically using tasks where humans with model assistance outperform both alone.
ybai-2211.03540.sZh: 可扩展监督问题可通过人类与模型协作在困难任务上超越单独表现来实证研究。

lingxixie-2211.02556.sEn: Pangu-Weather is the first AI-based method to outperform traditional numerical weather prediction in accuracy across all factors and time ranges.
lingxixie-2211.02556.sZh: 盘古天气是首个在准确度上超越传统数值天气预报的 AI 方法，覆盖所有气象要素和时间范围。

adefossez-2210.13438.sEn: We introduce a real-time, high-fidelity neural audio codec with a novel loss balancer and lightweight Transformer for further compression.
adefossez-2210.13438.sZh: 我们提出了一种实时高保真神经音频编解码器，采用新颖的损失平衡器和轻量级 Transformer 进一步压缩。

aqjiang-2210.12283.sEn: Draft, Sketch, and Prove (DSP) uses informal proofs to guide formal theorem provers, improving success rate from 20.9% to 39.3% on math competition problems.
aqjiang-2210.12283.sZh: DSP 方法利用非形式化证明指导形式化定理证明器，在数学竞赛问题集上将成功率从 20.9%提升至 39.3%。

hwchung-2210.11416.sEn: Instruction finetuning with more tasks, larger models, and chain-of-thought data significantly boosts performance across diverse models and benchmarks.
hwchung-2210.11416.sZh: 通过增加任务数量、扩大模型规模以及使用思维链数据进行指令微调，能显著提升各类模型在多种基准测试上的性能。

shunyuyao-2210.03629.sEn: ReAct synergizes reasoning and acting in LLMs, outperforming baselines on QA, fact verification, and interactive tasks.
shunyuyao-2210.03629.sZh: ReAct 协同语言模型中的推理与行动，在问答、事实验证和交互任务上超越基线。

jimfan-2210.03094.sEn: VIMA uses multimodal prompts to unify diverse robot manipulation tasks, achieving strong generalization and data efficiency.
jimfan-2210.03094.sZh: VIMA 通过多模态提示统一多种机器人操作任务，在零样本泛化中成功率提升 2.9 倍，数据效率提升 2.7 倍。

jietang-2210.02414.sEn: GLM-130B is a 130B bilingual model that outperforms GPT-3 on many benchmarks and achieves INT4 quantization without performance loss.
jietang-2210.02414.sZh: GLM-130B 是一个 1300 亿参数的双语预训练模型，在多个英文基准上超越 GPT-3，并首次实现百亿级模型的 INT4 量化，性能几乎无损。

anthropic-2209.10652.sEn: Polysemanticity in neural networks arises from storing sparse features in superposition, as demonstrated by a toy model with phase changes and connections to polytope geometry and adversarial examples.
anthropic-2209.10652.sZh: 神经网络中的多义性源于在叠加中存储稀疏特征，通过一个具有相变、与多面体几何和对抗样本关联的玩具模型得以证明。

nzeghidour-2209.03143.sEn: AudioLM generates high-quality audio with long-term consistency by treating audio generation as a language modeling task.
nzeghidour-2209.03143.sZh: AudioLM 通过将音频生成视为语言建模任务，实现了高质量且具有长期一致性的音频生成。

openai-approach-to-alignment.sEn: Our approach to alignment research focuses on improving AI systems' ability to learn from human feedback and assist humans in evaluating AI, aiming to build a sufficiently aligned AI system that can solve all other alignment problems.
openai-approach-to-alignment.sZh: 我们对齐研究的方法侧重于提升 AI 系统从人类反馈中学习以及协助人类评估 AI 的能力，旨在构建一个足够对齐的 AI 系统，以解决所有其他对齐问题。

anthropic-2209.07858.sEn: Red teaming language models reveals scaling challenges for RLHF models and provides a dataset of 38,961 attacks.
anthropic-2209.07858.sZh: 红队测试语言模型揭示了 RLHF 模型在扩展时的挑战，并提供了 38,961 次攻击的数据集。

jonathanho-2207.12598.sEn: Classifier-free guidance combines conditional and unconditional diffusion models to trade off sample quality and diversity without a separate classifier.
jonathanho-2207.12598.sZh: 无分类器引导通过联合训练条件和无条件扩散模型，结合两者的分数估计，在不依赖独立分类器的情况下实现样本质量与多样性的权衡。

anthropic-2207.05221.sEn: Language models can self-evaluate the validity of their own claims and predict answerability, with performance improving through self-consistency and context.
anthropic-2207.05221.sZh: 语言模型能够自我评估自身主张的有效性并预测可回答性，通过自洽性和上下文信息可提升表现。

jimfan-2206.08853.sEn: MineDojo integrates internet-scale knowledge with Minecraft to train generalist embodied agents on thousands of open-ended tasks.
jimfan-2206.08853.sZh: MineDojo 将互联网规模的知识与 Minecraft 游戏相结合，训练通用具身智能体完成数千种开放式任务。

jasonwei-2206.07682.sEn: Emergent abilities are unpredictable capabilities that appear only in large language models, not in smaller ones.
jasonwei-2206.07682.sZh: 涌现能力是指仅在大型语言模型中出现、而在较小模型中不存在的不可预测的能力。

junzhu-2206.00927.sEn: DPM-Solver generates high-quality samples in 10-20 steps by analytically solving the linear part of diffusion ODEs.
junzhu-2206.00927.sZh: DPM-Solver 通过解析求解扩散常微分方程的线性部分，仅需 10-20 步即可生成高质量样本。

tkarras-2206.00364.sEn: We present a clear design space for diffusion-based generative models, yielding new state-of-the-art FID scores on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet-64 with faster sampling.
tkarras-2206.00364.sZh: 我们提出了一个清晰的设计空间，在 CIFAR-10 和 ImageNet-64 上取得了新的最先进 FID 分数，且采样速度更快。

songhan-2205.14756.sEn: EfficientViT achieves global receptive field and multi-scale learning with lightweight, hardware-efficient operations, outperforming prior models in speed and accuracy on high-resolution dense prediction tasks.
songhan-2205.14756.sZh: EfficientViT 通过轻量且硬件高效的操作实现全局感受野和多尺度学习，在高分辨率密集预测任务中，其速度和精度均超越先前模型。

tridao-2205.14135.sEn: FlashAttention reduces GPU memory reads/writes via tiling, achieving faster training and longer context for Transformers.
tridao-2205.14135.sZh: FlashAttention 通过分块减少 GPU 内存读写，实现更快的训练速度和更长的上下文支持。

csaharia-2205.11487.sEn: Imagen achieves photorealistic text-to-image generation with deep language understanding by leveraging large language models.
csaharia-2205.11487.sZh: Imagen 通过利用大型语言模型，实现了具有深度语言理解能力的逼真文本到图像生成。

xiaohuazhai-2205.01917.sEn: CoCa jointly pretrains an image-text encoder-decoder with contrastive and captioning losses, achieving SOTA on diverse tasks.
xiaohuazhai-2205.01917.sZh: CoCa 通过对比损失和字幕损失联合预训练图像-文本编码器-解码器，在多种任务上达到最先进水平。

tonyfadell-jobs-storytelling-lessons.sEn: A good product story has three elements: facts, emotion, and a clear narrative.
tonyfadell-jobs-storytelling-lessons.sZh: 一个好的产品故事包含三个要素：事实、情感和清晰的叙事。

aarongrattafiori-2205.01068.sEn: We release OPT, a suite of decoder-only pre-trained transformers from 125M to 175B parameters, comparable to GPT-3 but with 1/7th the carbon footprint.
aarongrattafiori-2205.01068.sZh: 我们发布了 OPT，一系列从 125M 到 175B 参数的仅解码器预训练 Transformer，性能与 GPT-3 相当，但碳足迹仅为后者的七分之一。

jbalayrac-2204.14198.sEn: Flamingo achieves state-of-the-art few-shot learning on diverse visual tasks by bridging pretrained vision and language models.
jbalayrac-2204.14198.sZh: Flamingo 通过桥接预训练的视觉和语言模型，在多种视觉任务上实现了少样本学习的最优性能。

pdhariwal-2204.06125.sEn: Explicitly generating CLIP image embeddings improves image diversity with minimal loss in photorealism and caption similarity.
pdhariwal-2204.06125.sZh: 显式生成 CLIP 图像嵌入可在几乎不损失逼真度和标题相似性的情况下提高图像多样性。

ybai-2204.05862.sEn: RLHF alignment improves NLP performance and is compatible with specialized skills training.
ybai-2204.05862.sZh: RLHF 对齐训练提升了几乎所有 NLP 评估的性能，并且与专业技能训练完全兼容。

jonathanho-2204.03458.sEn: We propose a diffusion model for video generation that extends image diffusion, enabling joint training on images and videos, and introduces a conditional sampling technique for spatial-temporal extension.
jonathanho-2204.03458.sZh: 我们提出了一种视频生成扩散模型，它扩展了图像扩散，支持图像和视频联合训练，并引入了一种用于时空扩展的条件采样技术。

achowdhery-2204.02311.sEn: PaLM 540B achieves state-of-the-art few-shot learning on hundreds of tasks, outperforming finetuned models on multi-step reasoning and average human performance on BIG-bench.
achowdhery-2204.02311.sZh: PaLM 540B 在数百个任务上实现了最先进的少样本学习，在多步推理上超越微调模型，在 BIG-bench 上超越人类平均水平。

mahn-2204.01691.sEn: Grounding language models in robotic affordances enables robots to follow high-level instructions by combining semantic knowledge with feasible low-level skills.
mahn-2204.01691.sZh: 将语言模型扎根于机器人能力，通过结合语义知识与可行的底层技能，使机器人能够遵循高层指令。

jhoffmann-2203.15556.sEn: Model size and training tokens should be scaled equally for compute-optimal training.
jhoffmann-2203.15556.sZh: 在计算最优训练中，模型大小和训练令牌数应等比例缩放。

leizhangidea-2203.03605.sEn: DINO achieves state-of-the-art end-to-end object detection with improved denoising training, mixed query selection, and look forward twice scheme.
leizhangidea-2203.03605.sZh: DINO 通过对比去噪训练、混合查询选择和两次前向预测方案，在端到端目标检测中达到最优性能。

leike-2203.02155.sEn: Fine-tuning with human feedback aligns language models with user intent, enabling a 1.3B parameter model to outperform a 175B model.
leike-2203.02155.sZh: 通过人类反馈微调，语言模型能够更好地遵循用户意图，使得 1.3B 参数的模型在性能上优于 175B 参数的模型。

dario-2202.07785.sEn: Large generative models exhibit predictable loss scaling but unpredictable specific behaviors, creating policy challenges.
dario-2202.07785.sZh: 大型生成模型在整体损失上可预测，但具体能力、输入和输出却难以预料，这种矛盾给政策制定带来挑战。

baevski-2202.03555.sEn: data2vec proposes a unified self-supervised learning framework across speech, NLP, and vision by predicting contextualized latent representations instead of modality-specific targets.
baevski-2202.03555.sZh: data2vec 提出了一种跨语音、自然语言处理和视觉的统一自监督学习框架，通过预测上下文相关的潜在表示而非模态特定的目标。

jasonwei-2201.11903.sEn: Chain-of-thought prompting significantly improves complex reasoning in large language models.
jasonwei-2201.11903.sZh: 思维链提示显著提升大型语言模型的复杂推理能力。

junnanli-2201.12086.sEn: BLIP achieves state-of-the-art on vision-language tasks by bootstrapping captions from noisy web data.
junnanli-2201.12086.sZh: BLIP 通过从嘈杂网络数据中引导生成字幕，在视觉-语言任务上达到最先进水平。

aradford-2201.10005.sEn: Contrastive pre-training on unsupervised data at scale produces high-quality vector representations for text and code, achieving state-of-the-art results in classification and search tasks.
aradford-2201.10005.sZh: 大规模无监督数据上的对比预训练能够生成高质量的文本和代码向量表示，在分类和搜索任务中达到最优结果。

zhuangliu-2201.03545.sEn: Modernizing standard ResNet with Vision Transformer design principles yields ConvNeXt, a pure ConvNet family that matches or outperforms Transformers on ImageNet, COCO, and ADE20K.
zhuangliu-2201.03545.sZh: 通过借鉴 Vision Transformer 的设计理念对标准 ResNet 进行现代化改造，我们得到了纯卷积网络家族 ConvNeXt，其在 ImageNet、COCO 和 ADE20K 上性能媲美甚至超越 Transformer。

rrombach-2112.10752.sEn: Latent diffusion models achieve high-quality image synthesis with reduced computational cost by operating in the latent space of pretrained autoencoders.
rrombach-2112.10752.sZh: 潜在扩散模型通过在预训练自编码器的潜在空间中操作，以降低计算成本实现高质量图像合成。

openai-2112.09332.sEn: WebGPT fine-tunes GPT-3 to answer questions by browsing the web, achieving human-preferred answers 56% of the time over human demonstrators.
openai-2112.09332.sZh: WebGPT 通过微调 GPT-3 使其能在文本浏览器中搜索和导航网页来回答长问题，结合模仿学习和人类反馈优化答案质量，其答案在 56%的情况下比人类演示者更受青睐。

askell-2112.00861.sEn: Simple alignment techniques like prompting improve with model scale and generalize across evaluations without harming performance.
askell-2112.00861.sZh: 简单的对齐技术（如提示）随模型规模扩大而效果提升，且能泛化到多种对齐评估中，同时不损害性能。

ybai-2112.00861.sEn: Simple alignment techniques like prompting improve with model scale and generalize across evaluations without harming performance.
ybai-2112.00861.sZh: 简单的对齐技术（如提示）随模型规模扩大而效果提升，且能泛化到多种对齐评估中，同时不损害性能。

zhendaxie-2111.09886.sEn: SimMIM simplifies masked image modeling with random masking, raw pixel regression, and a linear prediction head, achieving strong results.
zhendaxie-2111.09886.sZh: SimMIM 通过随机掩码、原始像素回归和线性预测头简化了掩码图像建模，取得了优异的结果。

jinghaozhou-2111.07832.sEn: iBOT achieves masked image modeling with an online tokenizer via self-distillation, eliminating the need for pre-trained tokenizers and achieving state-of-the-art results on ImageNet-1K.
jinghaozhou-2111.07832.sZh: iBOT 通过自蒸馏实现带在线分词器的掩码图像建模，无需预训练分词器，在 ImageNet-1K 上达到最优结果。

kaiming-2111.06377.sEn: Masked autoencoders (MAE) are scalable self-supervised learners for computer vision, achieving high accuracy and efficient training.
kaiming-2111.06377.sZh: 掩码自编码器（MAE）是可扩展的计算机视觉自监督学习方法，实现了高精度和高效训练。

albertgu-2111.00396.sEn: S4 model achieves strong results on long-range sequence tasks, including solving Path-X of length 16k, while being efficient.
albertgu-2111.00396.sZh: S4 模型在长序列任务上取得强结果，包括解决长度 16k 的 Path-X 任务，同时保持高效。

openai-2110.14168.sEn: Training verifiers to judge model outputs significantly improves multi-step math reasoning performance.
openai-2110.14168.sZh: 训练验证器来判断模型输出的正确性，显著提升了多步数学推理的性能。

yejin-2110.07574.sEn: Teaching morality to AI is challenging, but the Delphi experiment shows promise and limitations.
yejin-2110.07574.sZh: 教 AI 道德充满挑战，但德尔斐实验展示了其潜力与局限。

ofirpress-2108.12409.sEn: ALiBi enables efficient extrapolation to longer sequences by biasing attention scores with distance-based penalties, outperforming sinusoidal embeddings with 11% faster training and less memory.
ofirpress-2108.12409.sZh: ALiBi 通过基于距离的惩罚偏置注意力分数，实现了对更长序列的高效外推，相比正弦位置嵌入，训练速度提升 11%，内存占用更少。

tworek-2107.03374.sEn: Codex, a GPT model fine-tuned on GitHub code, achieves 28.8% on HumanEval, with repeated sampling boosting performance to 70.2%.
tworek-2107.03374.sZh: Codex，一个在 GitHub 代码上微调的 GPT 模型，在 HumanEval 上达到 28.8%的准确率，通过重复采样可提升至 70.2%。

nzeghidour-2107.03312.sEn: SoundStream is a neural audio codec that efficiently compresses speech, music, and general audio at low bitrates, outperforming traditional codecs like Opus and approaching EVS quality.
nzeghidour-2107.03312.sZh: SoundStream 是一种神经音频编解码器，能以低比特率高效压缩语音、音乐和通用音频，性能优于 Opus 等传统编解码器，接近 EVS 质量。

openai-2107.03374.sEn: Codex, a GPT model fine-tuned on GitHub code, achieves 28.8% on HumanEval, with repeated sampling boosting performance to 70.2%.
openai-2107.03374.sZh: Codex，一个在 GitHub 代码上微调的 GPT 模型，在 HumanEval 上达到 28.8%的准确率，通过重复采样可提升至 70.2%。

wenhaiwang-2106.13797.sEn: PVT v2 improves PVT v1 with linear attention, overlapping patch embedding, and convolutional FFN, achieving SOTA on vision tasks.
wenhaiwang-2106.13797.sZh: PVT v2 通过线性注意力、重叠块嵌入和卷积前馈网络改进 PVT v1，在视觉任务上达到 SOTA。

tkarras-2106.12423.sEn: We identify that aliasing in GAN generators causes unhealthy dependence on absolute pixel coordinates, and propose small architectural changes to achieve translation and rotation equivariance.
tkarras-2106.12423.sZh: 我们发现生成对抗网络中的混叠现象导致了对绝对像素坐标的不健康依赖，并提出了小的架构变化以实现平移和旋转等变性。

furuwei-2106.08254.sEn: BEiT introduces masked image modeling for self-supervised vision Transformer pre-training, achieving competitive results on image classification and segmentation.
furuwei-2106.08254.sZh: BEiT 提出掩码图像建模用于视觉 Transformer 自监督预训练，在图像分类和分割上取得有竞争力的结果。

abdelmohamed-2106.07447.sEn: HuBERT uses offline clustering to provide target labels for masked prediction, achieving state-of-the-art performance on speech benchmarks.
abdelmohamed-2106.07447.sZh: HuBERT 利用离线聚类为掩码预测提供目标标签，在语音基准测试中达到最先进性能。

pdhariwal-2105.05233.sEn: Diffusion models achieve superior image quality to GANs with classifier guidance.
pdhariwal-2105.05233.sZh: 扩散模型通过分类器引导，在图像质量上超越 GAN。

abardes-2105.04906.sEn: VICReg explicitly avoids collapse in self-supervised learning by regularizing embedding variance and covariance.
abardes-2105.04906.sZh: VICReg 通过正则化嵌入的方差和协方差，明确避免了自监督学习中的崩溃问题。

mcaron-2104.14294.sEn: Self-supervised ViTs reveal explicit semantic segmentation and strong k-NN performance, leading to DINO method achieving 80.1% top-1 on ImageNet.
mcaron-2104.14294.sZh: 自监督 ViT 显式揭示语义分割信息，且 k-NN 分类性能优异，由此提出的 DINO 方法在 ImageNet 线性评估中达到 80.1% top-1 准确率。

pvelickovic-2104.13478.sEn: Deep learning's success stems from exploiting structural regularities in data, which can be unified through geometric principles to understand and design neural architectures.
pvelickovic-2104.13478.sZh: 深度学习的成功源于利用数据中的结构规律，这些规律可通过几何原理加以统一，从而理解和设计神经网络架构。

jianlinsu-2104.09864.sEn: Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) encodes absolute positions with rotation matrices and captures relative position dependencies, improving Transformer performance on long texts.
jianlinsu-2104.09864.sZh: 旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）通过旋转矩阵编码绝对位置并捕捉相对位置依赖，提升了 Transformer 在长文本上的性能。

zeliu-2103.14030.sEn: Swin Transformer achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple vision tasks with a hierarchical architecture and shifted windows.
zeliu-2103.14030.sZh: Swin Transformer 通过分层架构和移位窗口机制，在多个视觉任务上达到最优性能。

jietang-2103.10360.sEn: GLM outperforms BERT, T5, and GPT across NLU, conditional and unconditional generation tasks with a single pretrained model.
jietang-2103.10360.sZh: GLM 在自然语言理解、条件生成和无条件生成任务上，使用单一预训练模型超越了 BERT、T5 和 GPT。

jietang-2103.10385.sEn: P-Tuning uses trainable continuous prompt embeddings to stabilize and improve NLU performance across various tasks and settings.
jietang-2103.10385.sZh: P-Tuning 通过可训练的连续提示嵌入，稳定并提升了多种自然语言理解任务的性能。

sam-moores-law-for-everything.sEn: AI will reshape the economy, requiring a new social contract that taxes capital to distribute wealth fairly.
sam-moores-law-for-everything.sZh: 人工智能将重塑经济，需要新的社会契约，通过对资本征税来公平分配财富。

lecun-2103.03230.sEn: Barlow Twins avoids collapse by making the cross-correlation matrix close to identity, reducing redundancy between embedding components.
lecun-2103.03230.sZh: Barlow Twins 通过使互相关矩阵接近单位矩阵来避免坍塌，减少嵌入向量分量间的冗余。

aradford-2103.00020.sEn: Predicting which caption goes with which image is an efficient and scalable way to learn SOTA image representations from scratch.
aradford-2103.00020.sZh: 预测哪段文字描述对应哪张图像是一种高效且可扩展的方法，可以从零开始学习最先进的图像表示。

pingluo-2102.12122.sEn: PVT is a pyramid vision transformer backbone for dense prediction tasks, outperforming CNNs without convolutions.
pingluo-2102.12122.sZh: PVT 是一种用于密集预测任务的金字塔视觉 Transformer 骨干网络，无需卷积即可超越 CNN。

aradford-2102.12092.sEn: A simple transformer-based approach for zero-shot text-to-image generation achieves competitive results with domain-specific models when scaled with sufficient data.
aradford-2102.12092.sZh: 一种基于 transformer 的简单方法，通过将文本和图像令牌作为单一数据流进行自回归建模，在零样本评估中与领域特定模型竞争，且仅需足够的数据和规模。

chaojia-2102.05918.sEn: Scaling up visual and vision-language representation learning with noisy text supervision achieves state-of-the-art results.
chaojia-2102.05918.sZh: 利用噪声文本监督扩展视觉和视觉-语言表示学习，即使使用简单架构也能达到最先进水平。

fedus-2101.03961.sEn: Switch Transformers simplify MoE routing, reduce communication and training instability, enabling trillion-parameter models with up to 7x speedup.
fedus-2101.03961.sZh: Switch Transformers 简化了混合专家路由，降低了通信成本和训练不稳定性，实现了万亿参数模型，速度提升高达 7 倍。

xiangyuzhang-2101.03697.sEn: RepVGG achieves over 80% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet with a simple VGG-like architecture, running 83% faster than ResNet-50.
xiangyuzhang-2101.03697.sZh: RepVGG 通过结构重参数化技术，在推理时采用纯 VGG 风格网络，训练时使用多分支结构，在 ImageNet 上首次使普通模型达到 80%以上 top-1 准确率，且比 ResNet-50 快 83%。

deepmind-alphafold.sEn: AlphaFold solves a 50-year grand challenge in biology by predicting protein structures with high accuracy.
deepmind-alphafold.sZh: AlphaFold 通过高精度预测蛋白质结构，解决了生物学领域长达 50 年的重大挑战。

yangsong-2011.13456.sEn: We present a unified SDE framework for score-based generative modeling, enabling new sampling procedures, exact likelihood computation, and record-breaking image generation.
yangsong-2011.13456.sZh: 我们提出了一个统一的随机微分方程框架，用于分数生成建模，实现了新的采样程序、精确似然计算和创纪录的图像生成性能。

kaplan-2010.14701.sEn: Scaling laws for autoregressive transformers show power-law improvements in cross-entropy loss across diverse domains, enabling predictions of optimal model size and performance.
kaplan-2010.14701.sZh: 自回归 Transformer 在多个领域中的交叉熵损失遵循幂律加常数的缩放定律，可预测最优模型大小和性能。

adosovitskiy-2010.11929.sEn: A pure transformer applied directly to image patches can match or exceed state-of-the-art CNNs on image classification, with less training compute.
adosovitskiy-2010.11929.sZh: 直接将纯 Transformer 应用于图像块，可以在图像分类上达到或超越最先进的 CNN，且训练计算量更少。

jifengdai-2010.04159.sEn: Deformable DETR achieves better performance than DETR with 10x fewer training epochs by using attention modules that only attend to a small set of key sampling points.
jifengdai-2010.04159.sZh: 可变形 DETR 通过仅关注参考点周围少量关键采样点的注意力模块，以十分之一的训练周期实现了优于 DETR 的性能。

sermon-2010.02502.sEn: DDIMs accelerate sampling from diffusion models by 10-50x while maintaining high image quality.
sermon-2010.02502.sZh: DDIMs 将扩散模型的采样速度提升了 10 到 50 倍，同时保持了高质量的图像生成。

kchoroman-2009.14794.sEn: Performers achieve linear complexity for full-rank attention with provable accuracy.
kchoroman-2009.14794.sZh: Performer 以可证明的精度实现全秩注意力的线性复杂度。

louyang-2009.01325.sEn: Training summarization models with human feedback significantly improves summary quality over traditional methods.
louyang-2009.01325.sZh: 利用人类反馈训练摘要模型，能显著提升摘要质量，超越传统方法。

akatharo-2006.16236.sEn: Transformers can be reformulated as linear dot-products of kernel feature maps, reducing complexity from O(N^2) to O(N) and enabling iterative computation akin to RNNs.
akatharo-2006.16236.sZh: Transformer 可通过核特征映射的线性点积重新表述，将复杂度从 O(N²)降至 O(N)，并实现类似 RNN 的迭代计算。

baevski-2006.11477.sEn: wav2vec 2.0 outperforms semi-supervised methods by learning from raw audio alone, achieving state-of-the-art results with minimal labeled data.
baevski-2006.11477.sZh: wav2vec 2.0 仅通过原始音频学习，在少量标注数据上超越半监督方法，实现最先进结果。

jonathanho-2006.11239.sEn: We present high quality image synthesis using diffusion probabilistic models, achieving state-of-the-art FID scores on CIFAR10 and LSUN datasets.
jonathanho-2006.11239.sZh: 我们利用扩散概率模型实现了高质量的图像合成，在 CIFAR10 和 LSUN 数据集上取得了最先进的 FID 分数。

mcaron-2006.09882.sEn: SwAV achieves unsupervised learning by contrasting cluster assignments instead of pairwise features, enabling efficient scaling and strong performance.
mcaron-2006.09882.sZh: SwAV 通过对比聚类分配而非成对特征实现无监督学习，高效可扩展且性能强劲。

jbgrill-2006.07733.sEn: BYOL achieves state-of-the-art self-supervised learning without negative pairs.
jbgrill-2006.07733.sZh: BYOL 无需负样本对，实现了自监督学习的新高度。

gwern-scaling-hypothesis.sEn: Neural networks absorb data and compute, generalizing and becoming more Bayesian as problems get harder, manifesting new abilities even at trivial scale.
gwern-scaling-hypothesis.sZh: 神经网络吸收数据和计算，随着问题变难而泛化并变得更贝叶斯，即使在微不足道的规模下也能展现新能力。

tombrown-2005.14165.sEn: Scaling up language models greatly improves task-agnostic few-shot performance, sometimes reaching competitiveness with prior fine-tuning approaches.
tombrown-2005.14165.sZh: 扩大语言模型规模显著提升了任务无关的少样本性能，有时甚至能与先前的微调方法相媲美。

aradford-2005.14165.sEn: Scaling up language models greatly improves task-agnostic few-shot performance, sometimes reaching competitiveness with prior fine-tuning approaches.
aradford-2005.14165.sZh: 扩大语言模型规模显著提升了任务无关的少样本性能，有时甚至能与先前的微调方法相媲美。

ncarion-2005.12872.sEn: DETR simplifies object detection by treating it as a direct set prediction problem, eliminating hand-designed components like NMS and anchor generation.
ncarion-2005.12872.sZh: DETR 将目标检测视为直接集合预测问题，简化了检测流程，去除了非极大值抑制和锚点生成等手工设计组件。

gulati-2005.08100.sEn: Conformer combines CNNs and Transformers to capture both local and global dependencies, achieving state-of-the-art speech recognition results.
gulati-2005.08100.sZh: Conformer 结合 CNN 和 Transformer，有效捕捉局部和全局依赖，在语音识别中达到最优性能。

pdhariwal-2005.00341.sEn: Jukebox generates music with singing in raw audio using multi-scale VQ-VAE and autoregressive Transformers.
pdhariwal-2005.00341.sZh: Jukebox 使用多尺度 VQ-VAE 和自回归 Transformer 在原始音频域中生成带歌声的音乐。

izbeltagy-2004.05150.sEn: Longformer introduces a linear-scaling attention mechanism for processing long documents, achieving state-of-the-art results on multiple tasks.
izbeltagy-2004.05150.sZh: Longformer 提出了一种线性扩展的注意力机制，用于处理长文档，在多项任务上取得了最先进的结果。

kevinclarknlp-2003.10555.sEn: ELECTRA proposes a more sample-efficient pre-training task called replaced token detection, outperforming BERT and matching RoBERTa/XLNet with less compute.
kevinclarknlp-2003.10555.sZh: ELECTRA 提出了一种更高效的预训练任务——替换令牌检测，在相同计算量下优于 BERT，并以少于 1/4 的计算量达到 RoBERTa 和 XLNet 的性能。

xbresson-2003.00982.sEn: We present an updated benchmark for graph neural networks with a new molecular dataset and demonstrate its utility in exploring positional encoding.
xbresson-2003.00982.sZh: 我们提出了一个更新的图神经网络基准测试，包含一个新的分子数据集，并展示了其在探索位置编码方面的实用性。

shazeer-2002.05202.sEn: Variants of Gated Linear Units improve Transformer quality over ReLU or GELU.
shazeer-2002.05202.sZh: 门控线性单元（GLU）的变体在 Transformer 中优于常用的 ReLU 或 GELU 激活函数。

kaplan-2001.08361.sEn: Language model performance scales as a power-law with model size, dataset size, and compute, enabling optimal compute-efficient training with very large models on modest data.
kaplan-2001.08361.sZh: 语言模型性能随模型大小、数据集大小和计算量呈幂律缩放，从而可以在适度的数据上训练非常大的模型，实现计算效率最优的训练。

ilya-1912.02292.sEn: Double descent shows that increasing model size or training epochs can first hurt then help performance, and more data can sometimes worsen test results.
ilya-1912.02292.sZh: 双重下降现象表明，增加模型大小或训练轮数会先降低后提升性能，而增加训练样本有时反而会损害测试表现。

tkarras-1912.04958.sEn: We analyze artifacts in StyleGAN and propose improvements to generator normalization, progressive growing, and regularization, achieving state-of-the-art unconditional image quality.
tkarras-1912.04958.sZh: 我们分析了 StyleGAN 中的特征伪影，并提出了生成器归一化、渐进式增长和正则化方面的改进，实现了无条件图像生成的最先进质量。

dhafner-1912.01603.sEn: Dreamer learns behaviors by imagining future trajectories in a learned world model, achieving state-of-the-art performance on visual control tasks.
dhafner-1912.01603.sZh: Dreamer 通过在学到的世界模型中想象未来轨迹来学习行为，在视觉控制任务上达到了最先进的性能。

jschritt-1911.08265.sEn: MuZero achieves superhuman performance in Atari, Go, chess, and shogi by combining tree-based search with a learned model, without knowing the environment dynamics.
jschritt-1911.08265.sZh: MuZero 算法通过将基于树的搜索与学习模型相结合，在不了解环境动态的情况下，在雅达利、围棋、国际象棋和将棋中实现了超人类表现。

rgirshick-1911.05722.sEn: MoCo enables building a large and consistent dynamic dictionary for contrastive learning, achieving competitive results and even surpassing supervised pre-training in downstream tasks.
