rgirshick-1911.05722.sZh: MoCo 通过队列和移动平均编码器构建大型一致的动态字典，在对比学习中取得竞争性结果，甚至在下游任务中超越监督预训练。

craffel-1910.10683.sEn: A unified text-to-text framework enables systematic study of transfer learning techniques, achieving state-of-the-art results on multiple NLP benchmarks.
craffel-1910.10683.sZh: 统一的文本到文本框架系统研究了迁移学习技术，在多个 NLP 基准上取得了最先进的结果。

zhenzhonglan-1909.11942.sEn: ALBERT introduces parameter-reduction techniques to lower memory consumption and increase training speed, achieving state-of-the-art results with fewer parameters than BERT-large.
zhenzhonglan-1909.11942.sZh: ALBERT 通过参数缩减技术降低内存消耗并提升训练速度，以更少的参数在多个基准上超越 BERT-large，达到最优性能。

openai-1909.07528.sEn: Multi-agent competition in hide-and-seek leads to emergent tool use and coordination through self-supervised autocurricula.
openai-1909.07528.sZh: 通过多智能体竞争和简单的捉迷藏目标，智能体在自监督自动课程中涌现出复杂的工具使用和协作策略。

songhan-1908.09791.sEn: Train one network that supports diverse architectural settings and quickly specialize sub-networks for different devices without retraining.
songhan-1908.09791.sZh: 训练一个支持多种架构设置的网络，无需重新训练即可快速为不同设备定制子网络。

jwang-1908.07919.sEn: HRNet maintains high-resolution representations throughout the process, achieving richer semantics and higher spatial precision.
jwang-1908.07919.sZh: HRNet 在整个过程中保持高分辨率表示，实现了更丰富的语义和更高的空间精度。

liyuanliu-1908.03265.sEn: Warmup reduces early-stage variance of adaptive learning rates; RAdam rectifies this variance for better performance.
liyuanliu-1908.03265.sZh: 预热机制通过降低自适应学习率早期阶段的方差来稳定训练，而 RAdam 通过修正方差进一步提升了性能。

yinhanliu-1907.11692.sEn: RoBERTa shows that BERT was significantly undertrained and achieves state-of-the-art results by carefully optimizing hyperparameters and training data size.
yinhanliu-1907.11692.sZh: RoBERTa 发现 BERT 严重训练不足，通过精心优化超参数和训练数据规模，达到了最先进的结果。

yangsong-1907.05600.sEn: We propose a generative model using Langevin dynamics with score matching, achieving state-of-the-art results on CIFAR-10.
yangsong-1907.05600.sZh: 我们提出了一种基于分数匹配和朗之万动力学的生成模型，在 CIFAR-10 上取得了最优结果。

zhilinyang-1906.08237.sEn: XLNet outperforms BERT on 20 tasks by learning bidirectional contexts via permutation language modeling and integrating Transformer-XL.
zhilinyang-1906.08237.sZh: XLNet 通过排列语言建模学习双向上下文并集成 Transformer-XL，在 20 个任务上超越 BERT。

yejin-1906.05317.sEn: Generative models can automatically construct commonsense knowledge graphs with near-human precision.
yejin-1906.05317.sZh: 生成模型能够以接近人类的精度自动构建常识知识图谱。

yiren-1905.09263.sEn: FastSpeech achieves 270x speedup in mel-spectrogram generation and 38x in end-to-end speech synthesis while maintaining quality and robustness.
yiren-1905.09263.sZh: FastSpeech 在保持语音质量的同时，将梅尔频谱生成速度提升 270 倍，端到端语音合成速度提升 38 倍，并几乎消除了跳词和重复问题。

karpathy-recipe.sEn: A recipe to avoid common neural net mistakes by following a systematic training process.
karpathy-recipe.sZh: 通过遵循系统化的训练流程，避免常见的神经网络错误。

aradford-1904.10509.sEn: Sparse Transformers reduce attention complexity to O(n√n), enabling modeling of sequences up to tens of thousands of timesteps with hundreds of layers.
aradford-1904.10509.sZh: 稀疏 Transformer 将注意力复杂度降至 O(n√n)，能够用数百层网络建模长达数万时间步的序列。

yejin-1904.09751.sEn: Decoding strategies significantly affect machine text quality, and Nucleus Sampling improves diversity and fluency.
yejin-1904.09751.sZh: 解码策略显著影响机器文本质量，核采样方法能提升多样性与流畅性。

skale-1904.09237.sEn: Adam and related algorithms may fail to converge due to exponential moving averages; adding long-term memory of past gradients fixes the issue.
skale-1904.09237.sZh: Adam 等算法因指数移动平均可能导致不收敛，引入过去梯度的长期记忆可解决此问题。

yangyou-1904.00962.sEn: LAMB optimizer enables BERT training in 76 minutes with large batch sizes up to 32868.
yangyou-1904.00962.sZh: LAMB 优化器支持高达 32868 的大批量大小，将 BERT 训练时间从 3 天缩短至 76 分钟。

tpark-1903.07291.sEn: We propose spatially-adaptive normalization for photorealistic image synthesis from semantic layouts, outperforming previous methods in visual fidelity and layout alignment.
tpark-1903.07291.sZh: 我们提出空间自适应归一化，用于从语义布局合成逼真图像，在视觉保真度和布局对齐方面优于现有方法。

richsutton-bitter-lesson.sEn: The key lesson from 70 years of AI research is that general methods leveraging computation are ultimately most effective, due to Moore's law and the exponential decrease in computation cost.
richsutton-bitter-lesson.sZh: 从 70 年 AI 研究中得出的最大教训是，利用计算能力的通用方法最终最为有效，这得益于摩尔定律及计算成本持续指数级下降。

jwang-1902.09212.sEn: Our network maintains high-resolution representations throughout the whole process, leading to more accurate keypoint heatmaps.
jwang-1902.09212.sZh: 我们的网络在整个过程中保持高分辨率表示，从而得到更准确的关键点热图。

zihangdai-1901.02860.sEn: Transformer-XL enables learning longer-term dependency beyond fixed-length context with segment-level recurrence and novel positional encoding.
zihangdai-1901.02860.sZh: Transformer-XL 通过片段级循环机制和新型位置编码，实现了超越固定长度上下文的长期依赖学习。

dario-1812.06162.sEn: A simple statistic called the gradient noise scale predicts the largest useful batch size across many domains.
dario-1812.06162.sZh: 一个称为梯度噪声尺度的简单统计量可以预测多个领域中最大有用的批量大小。

tkarras-1812.04948.sEn: A style-based generator architecture for GANs enables unsupervised separation of high-level attributes and stochastic variation, improving quality and disentanglement.
tkarras-1812.04948.sZh: 一种基于风格的生成器架构实现了高层属性与随机变化的无监督分离，提升了生成质量和解耦能力。

dario-1810.08575.sEn: Iterated Amplification trains complex behaviors by combining solutions to easier subproblems without an external reward function.
dario-1810.08575.sZh: 迭代放大通过组合较易子问题的解决方案来训练复杂行为，无需外部奖励函数。

jdevlin-1810.04805.sEn: BERT pre-trains deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text, achieving state-of-the-art results on 11 NLP tasks.
jdevlin-1810.04805.sZh: BERT 通过从无标注文本中预训练深度双向表示，在 11 项自然语言处理任务上取得了最先进的结果。

kxu-1810.00826.sEn: GNNs are as powerful as the Weisfeiler-Lehman test but limited in distinguishing certain graph structures.
kxu-1810.00826.sZh: 图神经网络与 Weisfeiler-Lehman 测试能力相当，但在区分某些图结构上存在局限。

abrock-1809.11096.sEn: BigGANs achieve state-of-the-art class-conditional image synthesis on ImageNet at 128x128 resolution with IS 166.5 and FID 7.4.
abrock-1809.11096.sZh: BigGAN 在 128x128 分辨率的 ImageNet 上实现了类别条件图像合成的最新成果，IS 达到 166.5，FID 为 7.4。

zhilinyang-1809.09600.sEn: HotpotQA is a new dataset with 113k Wikipedia-based QA pairs requiring multi-document reasoning and providing sentence-level supporting facts for explainable predictions.
zhilinyang-1809.09600.sZh: HotpotQA 是一个包含 11.3 万个基于维基百科的问答对的新数据集，要求进行多文档推理，并提供句子级别的支持事实以实现可解释的预测。

jleskovec-1806.08804.sEn: DiffPool learns hierarchical graph representations via differentiable soft clustering, boosting GNN accuracy by 5-10%.
jleskovec-1806.08804.sZh: DiffPool 通过可微分软聚类学习层次化图表示，将 GNN 准确率提升 5-10%。

pbattaglia-1806.01261.sEn: Combinatorial generalization is key to human-like AI, and graph networks with relational inductive biases offer a promising path.
pbattaglia-1806.01261.sZh: 组合泛化是实现类人人工智能的关键，而具有关系归纳偏置的图网络提供了一条有前景的路径。

amadry-1805.11604.sEn: Batch Normalization makes the optimization landscape smoother, enabling faster and more stable training.
amadry-1805.11604.sZh: 批归一化使优化景观更平滑，从而实现更快、更稳定的训练。

goodfellow-1805.08318.sEn: SAGAN introduces self-attention to GANs for long-range dependency modeling, achieving state-of-the-art results on ImageNet.
goodfellow-1805.08318.sZh: SAGAN 将自注意力机制引入生成对抗网络，实现长距离依赖建模，在 ImageNet 上取得了最优结果。

dario-1805.00899.sEn: Debate with optimal play can answer any question in PSPACE given polynomial time judges, while direct judging answers only NP questions.
dario-1805.00899.sZh: 在最优辩论下，给定多项式时间的裁判，可以回答 PSPACE 中的任何问题，而直接评判只能回答 NP 问题。

shazeer-1804.04235.sEn: Adafactor reduces memory usage in adaptive optimizers by factorizing second-moment estimates, achieving comparable results to Adam with minimal storage.
shazeer-1804.04235.sZh: Adafactor 通过分解二阶矩估计来减少自适应优化器的内存使用，在极小存储下达到与 Adam 相当的效果。

jredmon-1804.02767.sEn: YOLOv3 is a fast and accurate object detector, achieving 57.9 mAP@50 in 51 ms on a Titan X, 3.8x faster than RetinaNet with similar performance.
jredmon-1804.02767.sZh: YOLOv3 是一个快速且准确的目标检测器，在 Titan X 上以 51 毫秒达到 57.9 mAP@50，性能与 RetinaNet 相当但速度快 3.8 倍。

dha-1803.10122.sEn: We can train an agent entirely inside its own hallucinated dream generated by its world model and transfer the policy back to the actual environment.
dha-1803.10122.sZh: 我们可以在世界模型生成的幻觉梦境中完全训练智能体，并将策略迁移回真实环境。

tmiyato-1802.05957.sEn: Spectral normalization stabilizes GAN training by normalizing the weight matrix's spectral norm, improving image generation quality.
tmiyato-1802.05957.sZh: 谱归一化通过归一化权重矩阵的谱范数来稳定 GAN 训练，提升图像生成质量。

mpeters-1802.05365.sEn: Deep contextualized word representations significantly improve NLP tasks by modeling complex word characteristics and polysemy.
mpeters-1802.05365.sZh: 深度上下文词表示通过建模单词的复杂特征和多义性，显著提升了自然语言处理任务的表现。

lcchen-1802.02611.sEn: DeepLabv3+ combines spatial pyramid pooling and encoder-decoder structures for sharper boundaries and multi-scale context.
lcchen-1802.02611.sZh: DeepLabv3+结合空间金字塔池化和编码器-解码器结构，实现更清晰的边界和多尺度上下文。

mbronstein-1801.07829.sEn: EdgeConv captures local neighborhood information and semantic characteristics over long distances in point clouds.
mbronstein-1801.07829.sZh: EdgeConv 能够捕捉点云中的局部邻域信息以及长距离语义特征。

sruder-1801.06146.sEn: ULMFiT enables effective transfer learning for any NLP task, achieving state-of-the-art results with significantly less data.
sruder-1801.06146.sZh: ULMFiT 实现了对任何 NLP 任务的有效迁移学习，用更少的数据取得了最先进的结果。

abbeel-1801.01290.sEn: Soft Actor-Critic achieves state-of-the-art performance on continuous control tasks with high stability and sample efficiency.
abbeel-1801.01290.sZh: 软演员-评论家算法在连续控制任务上实现了最先进的性能，具有高稳定性和样本效率。

jshen-1712.05884.sEn: Tacotron 2 achieves natural speech synthesis with a MOS of 4.53, comparable to professional recordings.
jshen-1712.05884.sZh: Tacotron 2 实现了与专业录音相媲美的自然语音合成，平均意见得分（MOS）为 4.53。

antonoglou-1712.01815.sEn: AlphaZero achieves superhuman performance in chess, shogi, and Go through self-play reinforcement learning with no domain knowledge beyond game rules.
antonoglou-1712.01815.sZh: AlphaZero 通过自我对弈强化学习，在仅知游戏规则而无领域知识的情况下，在国际象棋、将棋和围棋中达到超人类水平。

demis-1712.01815.sEn: AlphaZero achieves superhuman performance in chess, shogi, and Go through self-play reinforcement learning with no domain knowledge beyond game rules.
demis-1712.01815.sZh: AlphaZero 通过自我对弈强化学习，在仅知游戏规则而无领域知识的情况下，在国际象棋、将棋和围棋中达到超人类水平。

fchollet-impossibility-intelligence-expl.sEn: Intelligence explosion is impossible due to environmental limits and the externalization of intelligence in civilization.
fchollet-impossibility-intelligence-expl.sZh: 智能爆炸不可能发生，因为环境对个体智能有硬性限制，且大部分智能外化于文明中。

yunjeychoi-1711.09020.sEn: StarGAN enables multi-domain image translation with a single model, outperforming existing approaches.
yunjeychoi-1711.09020.sZh: StarGAN 使用单一模型实现多域图像翻译，性能优于现有方法。

fhutter-1711.05101.sEn: Decoupling weight decay from optimization steps improves generalization in adaptive gradient methods like Adam.
fhutter-1711.05101.sZh: 将权重衰减与优化步骤解耦，可提升 Adam 等自适应梯度方法的泛化性能。

karpathy-software-2-0.sEn: Neural networks represent a fundamental shift in software development, moving from explicit programming to data-driven optimization.
karpathy-software-2-0.sZh: 神经网络代表了软件开发的根本性转变，从显式编程转向数据驱动的优化。

zhilinyang-1711.03953.sEn: We propose a high-rank RNN language model that overcomes the Softmax bottleneck, achieving state-of-the-art perplexities on multiple benchmarks.
zhilinyang-1711.03953.sZh: 我们提出了一种高秩 RNN 语言模型，克服了 Softmax 瓶颈，在多个基准上取得了最先进的困惑度。

pvelickovic-1710.10903.sEn: Graph Attention Networks (GATs) use masked self-attention to assign different weights to different nodes in a neighborhood, improving upon graph convolution methods.
pvelickovic-1710.10903.sZh: 图注意力网络（GATs）利用掩蔽自注意力机制为邻域中的不同节点分配不同权重，改进了图卷积方法。

tkarras-1710.10196.sEn: Progressive growing of GANs enables high-resolution image synthesis with improved quality, stability, and variation.
tkarras-1710.10196.sZh: 渐进式增长生成对抗网络能够生成高质量、高分辨率图像，同时提升训练稳定性和图像多样性。

hinton-1710.09829.sEn: A capsule network with dynamic routing achieves state-of-the-art on MNIST and excels at recognizing overlapping digits.
hinton-1710.09829.sZh: 一种采用动态路由机制的胶囊网络在 MNIST 上达到最优性能，并在识别高度重叠数字方面显著优于卷积网络。

hvanhasselt-1710.02298.sEn: Combining six DQN extensions yields state-of-the-art Atari performance.
hvanhasselt-1710.02298.sZh: 将六种 DQN 扩展相结合，在 Atari 基准上实现了最先进的性能。

yangyou-1708.03888.sEn: Layer-wise Adaptive Rate Scaling (LARS) enables large batch training of convolutional networks without accuracy loss.
yangyou-1708.03888.sZh: 逐层自适应学习率缩放（LARS）使得卷积网络的大批量训练在不损失精度的情况下成为可能。

tsungyilin-1708.02002.sEn: Focal Loss addresses extreme class imbalance in dense object detectors, enabling RetinaNet to surpass two-stage detectors in accuracy while maintaining one-stage speed.
tsungyilin-1708.02002.sZh: 焦点损失解决了密集目标检测中的极端类别不平衡问题，使 RetinaNet 在保持单阶段速度的同时，超越了所有现有两阶段检测器的精度。

mbellemare-1707.06887.sEn: Modeling the full distribution of returns, not just the expected value, improves reinforcement learning performance.
mbellemare-1707.06887.sZh: 建模回报的完整分布而非仅期望值，能提升强化学习性能。

schulman-1707.06347.sEn: We propose proximal policy optimization (PPO), a new family of policy gradient methods that is simpler, more general, and has better sample complexity than trust region policy optimization.
schulman-1707.06347.sZh: 我们提出了一种新的策略梯度方法家族——近端策略优化（PPO），它比信任区域策略优化更简单、更通用，且样本复杂度更低。

mandrychow-1707.01495.sEn: Hindsight Experience Replay enables sample-efficient learning from sparse, binary rewards, eliminating the need for reward engineering.
mandrychow-1707.01495.sZh: 后见经验回放实现了从稀疏二元奖励中的样本高效学习，无需进行奖励工程。

xiangyuzhang-1707.01083.sEn: ShuffleNet introduces pointwise group convolution and channel shuffle to achieve high efficiency on mobile devices.
xiangyuzhang-1707.01083.sZh: ShuffleNet 通过逐点分组卷积和通道混洗操作，在移动设备上实现了极高的计算效率。

shazeer-1706.03762.sEn: The Transformer model, based solely on attention mechanisms, outperforms recurrent and convolutional models in machine translation while being more parallelizable and faster to train.
shazeer-1706.03762.sZh: 仅基于注意力机制的 Transformer 模型在机器翻译中优于循环和卷积模型，且更易并行化、训练更快。

christiano-1706.03741.sEn: We can train complex RL behaviors using human preferences on trajectory segments, requiring feedback on less than 1% of agent interactions.
christiano-1706.03741.sZh: 我们可以通过人类对轨迹片段的偏好来训练复杂的强化学习行为，仅需对不到 1%的智能体交互提供反馈。

shochreiter-1706.02515.sEn: Self-normalizing neural networks (SNNs) with SELU activations automatically converge to zero mean and unit variance, enabling deep architectures and robust learning.
shochreiter-1706.02515.sZh: 自归一化神经网络（SNN）使用 SELU 激活函数，自动收敛到零均值和单位方差，从而支持深层架构和鲁棒学习。

wlhamilton-1706.02216.sEn: GraphSAGE learns a function to generate node embeddings by sampling and aggregating features from local neighborhoods, enabling generalization to unseen nodes.
wlhamilton-1706.02216.sZh: GraphSAGE 通过学习一个从节点局部邻域采样并聚合特征来生成嵌入的函数，从而能够泛化到未见节点。

jgilmer-1704.01212.sEn: We reformulate existing models into a common framework called Message Passing Neural Networks (MPNNs) and achieve state-of-the-art results on molecular property prediction.
jgilmer-1704.01212.sZh: 我们将现有模型重新表述为一个称为消息传递神经网络（MPNNs）的通用框架，并在分子性质预测上取得了最先进的结果。

arjovsky-1704.00028.sEn: We propose penalizing the gradient norm of the critic with respect to its input, which stabilizes GAN training and avoids issues caused by weight clipping in WGAN.
arjovsky-1704.00028.sZh: 我们提出对判别器关于输入的梯度范数进行惩罚，从而稳定 GAN 训练，避免 WGAN 中权重裁剪导致的问题。

junyanzhu-1703.10593.sEn: We propose CycleGAN, a method for unpaired image-to-image translation using cycle-consistent adversarial networks.
junyanzhu-1703.10593.sZh: 我们提出了 CycleGAN，一种使用循环一致性对抗网络进行非配对图像到图像翻译的方法。

abbeel-1703.06907.sEn: Domain randomization enables training deep neural networks on simulated images that transfer to real-world object localization and grasping without any real data.
abbeel-1703.06907.sZh: 域随机化技术使得仅使用模拟图像训练的深度神经网络能够成功迁移到现实世界，实现物体定位和抓取，无需任何真实数据。

rgirshick-1703.06870.sEn: Mask R-CNN is a simple, flexible, and general framework for object instance segmentation that extends Faster R-CNN by adding a branch for predicting segmentation masks.
rgirshick-1703.06870.sZh: Mask R-CNN 是一个简单、灵活且通用的物体实例分割框架，它通过添加一个用于预测分割掩码的分支来扩展 Faster R-CNN。

jifengdai-1703.06211.sEn: Deformable Convolution and Deformable RoI Pooling enhance CNNs' ability to model geometric transformations by learning spatial offsets without extra supervision.
jifengdai-1703.06211.sZh: 可变形卷积和可变形 RoI 池化通过学习空间偏移，无需额外监督，增强了 CNN 对几何变换的建模能力。

kendall-1703.04977.sEn: Two types of uncertainty, aleatoric and epistemic, are modeled in Bayesian deep learning for computer vision, with aleatoric capturing observation noise and epistemic capturing model uncertainty that can be reduced with more data.
kendall-1703.04977.sZh: 贝叶斯深度学习在计算机视觉中建模两种不确定性：偶然不确定性捕捉观测噪声，认知不确定性捕捉模型不确定性，后者可通过更多数据消除。

finn-1703.03400.sEn: A model-agnostic meta-learning algorithm that enables fast adaptation of deep networks with few gradient steps.
finn-1703.03400.sZh: 一种模型无关的元学习算法，通过少量梯度步骤实现深度网络的快速适应。

arjovsky-1701.07875.sEn: WGAN improves GAN training stability, eliminates mode collapse, and provides meaningful loss curves.
arjovsky-1701.07875.sZh: WGAN 改进了 GAN 训练的稳定性，消除了模式崩溃，并提供了有意义的损失曲线。

shazeer-1701.06538.sEn: Sparsely-Gated Mixture-of-Experts layer enables >1000x model capacity increase with minor computational efficiency loss on modern GPU clusters.
shazeer-1701.06538.sZh: 稀疏门控专家混合层能够在现代 GPU 集群上实现超过 1000 倍的模型容量提升，同时仅带来轻微的计算效率损失。

jredmon-1612.08242.sEn: YOLO9000 is a real-time object detection system that detects over 9000 categories, achieving state-of-the-art results on standard benchmarks while running significantly faster.
jredmon-1612.08242.sZh: YOLO9000 是一个实时目标检测系统，可检测超过 9000 个类别，在标准基准上达到最先进水平，同时运行速度显著更快。

tsungyilin-1612.03144.sEn: Feature Pyramid Networks (FPN) improve multi-scale object detection by leveraging deep convolutional networks' inherent pyramid hierarchy with minimal extra cost.
tsungyilin-1612.03144.sZh: 特征金字塔网络（FPN）利用深度卷积网络固有的金字塔层次结构，以极小的额外成本提升多尺度目标检测性能。

mbronstein-1611.08097.sEn: Geometric deep learning extends deep neural networks to non-Euclidean domains like graphs and manifolds.
mbronstein-1611.08097.sZh: 几何深度学习将深度神经网络扩展到图、流形等非欧几里得域。

pisola-1611.07004.sEn: Conditional adversarial networks serve as a general-purpose solution for image-to-image translation, learning both the mapping and the loss function.
pisola-1611.07004.sZh: 条件对抗网络作为图像到图像翻译的通用解决方案，同时学习映射和损失函数。

oriol-1611.03530.sEn: Large neural networks can fit random labels and noise, challenging traditional views of generalization.
oriol-1611.03530.sZh: 大型神经网络可以拟合随机标签和噪声，挑战了传统的泛化观点。

avdoord-1609.03499.sEn: WaveNet is a deep neural network for generating raw audio waveforms, achieving state-of-the-art text-to-speech performance and realistic music generation.
avdoord-1609.03499.sZh: WaveNet 是一种用于生成原始音频波形的深度神经网络，在文本转语音任务中达到最先进水平，并能生成逼真的音乐片段。

tkipf-1609.02907.sEn: A scalable semi-supervised learning approach using graph convolutional networks outperforms related methods on citation networks and knowledge graphs.
tkipf-1609.02907.sZh: 一种基于图卷积网络的可扩展半监督学习方法，在引文网络和知识图谱上显著优于相关方法。

gaohuang-1608.06993.sEn: DenseNet connects each layer to every other layer, improving accuracy and efficiency.
gaohuang-1608.06993.sZh: DenseNet 将每一层与所有其他层连接，提升了准确性和效率。

fhutter-1608.03983.sEn: A simple warm restart technique for SGD improves anytime performance and achieves state-of-the-art results on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100.
fhutter-1608.03983.sZh: 一种简单的 SGD 热重启技术提升了任意时刻的性能，并在 CIFAR-10 和 CIFAR-100 上取得了最先进的结果。

jimmyba-1607.06450.sEn: Layer normalization normalizes neuron inputs across features within a single training case, stabilizing recurrent network training.
jimmyba-1607.06450.sZh: 层归一化对单个训练样本中同一层的所有神经元输入进行归一化，有效稳定循环网络的训练过程。

tmikolov-1607.04606.sEn: We propose a fast skipgram-based method that represents words as bags of character n-grams, achieving state-of-the-art performance on word similarity and analogy tasks across nine languages.
tmikolov-1607.04606.sZh: 我们提出一种基于 skipgram 的快速方法，将单词表示为字符 n-gram 的集合，在九种语言的词相似性和类比任务上达到了最先进水平。

mdefferrard-1606.09375.sEn: We generalize CNNs to graphs using spectral graph theory, achieving linear complexity and universal applicability.
mdefferrard-1606.09375.sZh: 我们将卷积神经网络从规则网格推广到图结构，利用谱图理论设计快速局部滤波器，保持线性复杂度并适用于任意图。

dario-1606.06565.sEn: We identify five concrete research problems in AI safety: avoiding side effects, avoiding reward hacking, scalable supervision, safe exploration, and distributional shift.
dario-1606.06565.sZh: 我们识别出人工智能安全中的五个具体研究问题：避免副作用、避免奖励黑客、可扩展监督、安全探索和分布偏移。

oriol-1606.04080.sEn: A novel framework combining metric learning with external memories achieves state-of-the-art one-shot learning on vision and language tasks.
oriol-1606.04080.sZh: 一种结合度量学习与外部记忆的新框架在视觉和语言任务上实现了最先进的单样本学习性能。

lcchen-1606.00915.sEn: DeepLab combines atrous convolution, ASPP, and fully connected CRFs to achieve state-of-the-art semantic segmentation.
lcchen-1606.00915.sZh: DeepLab 结合空洞卷积、ASPP 和全连接 CRF，实现了语义分割的最新成果。

justinjohnson-1603.08155.sEn: Perceptual loss functions enable feed-forward networks to achieve real-time style transfer and improved super-resolution quality.
justinjohnson-1603.08155.sZh: 感知损失函数使前馈网络能够实现实时风格迁移并提升超分辨率质量。

tianqi-1603.02754.sEn: XGBoost is a scalable tree boosting system that achieves state-of-the-art results on many machine learning challenges using novel sparsity-aware algorithms and efficient system optimizations.
tianqi-1603.02754.sZh: XGBoost 是一种可扩展的树提升系统，通过新颖的稀疏感知算法和高效的系统优化，在众多机器学习挑战中取得了最先进的结果。

dkingma-1602.07868.sEn: Weight normalization decouples weight vector length from direction, speeding up SGD convergence without batch dependencies.
dkingma-1602.07868.sZh: 权重归一化将权重向量的长度与方向解耦，在不引入批次依赖的情况下加速随机梯度下降收敛。

feifei-1602.07332.sEn: We present Visual Genome, a dataset with over 100K images densely annotated with objects, attributes, and relationships to enable cognitive tasks like image description and question answering.
feifei-1602.07332.sZh: 我们提出了 Visual Genome 数据集，包含超过 10 万张图像，每张图像平均有 21 个物体、18 个属性和 18 个物体间关系，旨在支持图像描述和问答等认知任务。

vmnih-1602.01783.sEn: Asynchronous methods stabilize training and achieve state-of-the-art results on Atari using only CPU.
vmnih-1602.01783.sZh: 异步方法稳定了训练过程，并仅使用 CPU 就在 Atari 领域取得了最先进的结果。

kaiming-1512.03385.sEn: Residual networks enable training of substantially deeper networks with improved accuracy and efficiency.
kaiming-1512.03385.sZh: 残差网络使得训练更深的网络成为可能，并提高了准确性和效率。

dario-1512.02595.sEn: End-to-end deep learning achieves competitive speech recognition in English and Mandarin, accelerated by HPC techniques.
dario-1512.02595.sZh: 端到端深度学习在英语和普通话语音识别上达到竞争性水平，并通过高性能计算技术实现加速。

cszegedy-1512.00567.sEn: Factorized convolutions and aggressive regularization enable efficient scaling of deep networks, achieving 3.5% top-5 error on ILSVRC 2012.
cszegedy-1512.00567.sZh: 通过分解卷积和激进的正则化，实现了深度网络的高效扩展，在 ILSVRC 2012 上达到 3.5%的 top-5 错误率。

aradford-1511.06434.sEn: DCGANs learn hierarchical representations from object parts to scenes in an unsupervised manner.
aradford-1511.06434.sZh: DCGAN 以无监督方式学习从物体部件到场景的层次化表示。

tschaul-1511.05952.sEn: Prioritizing important transitions in experience replay improves learning efficiency and achieves state-of-the-art performance in DQN.
tschaul-1511.05952.sZh: 优先回放重要经验能提高学习效率，并在 DQN 中达到最优性能。

songhan-1510.00149.sEn: Deep compression reduces neural network storage by 35x-49x without accuracy loss via pruning, quantization, and Huffman coding.
songhan-1510.00149.sZh: 深度压缩通过剪枝、量化和霍夫曼编码，在不损失精度的情况下将神经网络存储减少 35 倍至 49 倍。

hvanhasselt-1509.06461.sEn: Double Q-learning reduces overestimations in DQN, improving performance on Atari games.
hvanhasselt-1509.06461.sZh: 双 Q 学习减少了 DQN 中的过高估计，从而在多个 Atari 游戏中提升了性能。

tlillicrap-1509.02971.sEn: We adapt Deep Q-Learning to continuous action domains using an actor-critic, model-free algorithm based on deterministic policy gradients, achieving competitive performance on over 20 simulated physics tasks.
tlillicrap-1509.02971.sZh: 我们将深度 Q 学习的思想扩展到连续动作领域，提出了一种基于确定性策略梯度的演员-评论家、无模型算法，在 20 多个模拟物理任务上取得了与规划算法相媲美的性能。

rsennrich-1508.07909.sEn: Encoding rare and unknown words as sequences of subword units enables open-vocabulary translation in NMT, improving BLEU by 1.1 and 1.3 on English-German and English-Russian tasks.
rsennrich-1508.07909.sZh: 将罕见词和未知词编码为子词单元序列，使 NMT 模型能够进行开放词汇翻译，在英德和英俄翻译任务上分别提升 1.1 和 1.3 BLEU。

chrisolah-understanding-lstms.sEn: LSTM networks address the limitation of traditional neural networks by allowing information to persist through loops, enabling them to use context from previous inputs.
chrisolah-understanding-lstms.sZh: LSTM 网络通过循环结构允许信息持久化，解决了传统神经网络无法利用先前输入上下文的问题。

oriol-1506.03134.sEn: Pointer Networks use attention as a pointer to select input elements as output, enabling solutions to problems with variable-size output dictionaries.
oriol-1506.03134.sZh: 指针网络利用注意力机制作为指针，从输入序列中选择元素作为输出，从而解决输出字典大小可变的问题。

jredmon-1506.02640.sEn: YOLO frames object detection as a regression problem, enabling real-time processing with a single neural network.
jredmon-1506.02640.sZh: YOLO 将目标检测视为回归问题，通过单个神经网络实现实时处理。

karpathy-1506.02078.sEn: LSTM networks learn interpretable cells that track long-range dependencies like line lengths and brackets, outperforming n-gram models on structural patterns.
karpathy-1506.02078.sZh: LSTM 网络能够学习可解释的细胞，追踪如行长度和括号等长距离依赖，在结构模式上优于 n-gram 模型。

rgirshick-1506.01497.sEn: Faster R-CNN introduces a Region Proposal Network that shares convolutional features with the detection network, enabling nearly cost-free region proposals and real-time object detection.
rgirshick-1506.01497.sZh: Faster R-CNN 通过引入与检测网络共享卷积特征的区域提议网络，实现了几乎无成本的区域提议和实时目标检测。

oronneberger-1505.04597.sEn: U-Net achieves state-of-the-art segmentation with few images via strong data augmentation and a symmetric encoder-decoder architecture.
oronneberger-1505.04597.sZh: U-Net 通过强大的数据增强和对称的编码器-解码器架构，仅用少量图像即可实现最先进的分割性能。

rgirshick-1504.08083.sEn: Fast R-CNN achieves faster training and testing speeds with higher accuracy for object detection.
rgirshick-1504.08083.sZh: Fast R-CNN 在目标检测中实现了更快的训练和测试速度以及更高的准确率。

svlevine-1504.00702.sEn: Jointly training perception and control end-to-end yields better performance than separate training for visuomotor policies.
svlevine-1504.00702.sZh: 联合训练感知和控制系统端到端比单独训练每个组件能获得更好的性能。

jsohldick-1503.03585.sEn: A novel generative model inspired by non-equilibrium statistical physics that learns to reverse a diffusion process to restore data structure.
jsohldick-1503.03585.sZh: 受非平衡统计物理启发，通过逆向扩散过程恢复数据结构，实现灵活且可处理的深度生成模型。

hinton-1503.02531.sEn: Distilling knowledge from an ensemble into a single model improves performance and efficiency.
hinton-1503.02531.sZh: 将集成模型的知识蒸馏到单个模型中，可提升性能并降低计算成本。

schulman-1502.05477.sEn: TRPO is a practical algorithm for optimizing policies with guaranteed monotonic improvement, effective for large nonlinear policies like neural networks.
schulman-1502.05477.sZh: TRPO 是一种实用的策略优化算法，能保证单调改进，适用于神经网络等大型非线性策略。

cszegedy-1502.03167.sEn: Batch Normalization allows higher learning rates, reduces need for Dropout, and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with fewer training steps.
cszegedy-1502.03167.sZh: 批量归一化允许使用更高的学习率，减少对 Dropout 的需求，并以更少的训练步骤达到最先进的准确率。

timurban-ai-revolution-part1.sEn: The AI revolution is the most important topic for our future, comparable to the rise of human life on Earth.
timurban-ai-revolution-part1.sZh: 人工智能革命是我们未来最重要的议题，其意义堪比地球上人类生命的崛起。

dkingma-1412.6980.sEn: Adam is an efficient stochastic optimization algorithm based on adaptive estimates of lower-order moments.
dkingma-1412.6980.sZh: Adam 是一种基于低阶矩自适应估计的高效随机优化算法。

karpathy-1412.2306.sEn: A model combining CNNs and RNNs with a structured objective aligns visual and language data to generate novel image descriptions.
karpathy-1412.2306.sZh: 一种结合卷积神经网络和循环神经网络的结构化目标模型，对齐视觉和语言数据，生成新颖的图像描述。

oriol-1411.4555.sEn: A neural image caption generator combining computer vision and machine translation achieves state-of-the-art BLEU scores on multiple datasets.
oriol-1411.4555.sZh: 一种结合计算机视觉和机器翻译的神经图像描述生成模型，在多个数据集上取得了最先进的 BLEU 分数。

mmirza-1411.1784.sEn: Conditional GANs enable controlled data generation by conditioning on additional information like class labels.
mmirza-1411.1784.sZh: 条件 GAN 通过附加信息（如类别标签）实现可控数据生成。

cszegedy-1409.4842.sEn: We propose Inception, a deep CNN architecture that achieves state-of-the-art results in ILSVRC 2014 by efficiently using computing resources to increase depth and width.
cszegedy-1409.4842.sZh: 我们提出了名为“Inception”的深度卷积神经网络架构，该架构通过高效利用计算资源增加网络深度和宽度，在 ILSVRC 2014 分类与检测任务中达到了最优水平。

ilya-1409.3215.sEn: A deep LSTM-based end-to-end approach achieves BLEU 34.8 on WMT'14 English-French translation, outperforming a phrase-based SMT system (33.3) and reaching 36.5 when reranking SMT hypotheses.
ilya-1409.3215.sZh: 基于深度 LSTM 的端到端方法在 WMT'14 英法翻译任务上取得 BLEU 34.8，优于基于短语的统计机器翻译系统（33.3），并在重排序其假设后达到 36.5。

ilya-1409.2329.sEn: We present a simple regularization technique for RNNs with LSTM units, showing that correctly applied dropout substantially reduces overfitting across multiple tasks.
ilya-1409.2329.sZh: 我们提出了一种针对长短期记忆（LSTM）单元的循环神经网络（RNN）的简单正则化技术，展示了正确应用 dropout 可以显著减少多种任务上的过拟合。

ksimonyan-1409.1556.sEn: Increasing depth with small 3x3 filters significantly improves accuracy, achieving 16-19 weight layers.
ksimonyan-1409.1556.sZh: 使用小尺寸 3x3 卷积滤波器增加网络深度可显著提升准确率，最佳深度为 16-19 个权重层。

bengio-1409.0473.sEn: Neural machine translation can be improved by allowing the model to automatically search for relevant parts of the source sentence without encoding it into a fixed-length vector.
bengio-1409.0473.sZh: 神经机器翻译可以通过让模型自动搜索源句子的相关部分而不将其编码为固定长度向量来改进。

feifei-1409.0575.sEn: The ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge is a benchmark for object category classification and detection, driving advances in computer vision.
feifei-1409.0575.sZh: ImageNet 大规模视觉识别挑战赛是物体分类与检测的基准，推动了计算机视觉的进步。

bengio-1406.2661.sEn: We propose a new framework for estimating generative models via an adversarial process, where a generative model and a discriminative model are trained simultaneously, with the generator aiming to fool the discriminator.
bengio-1406.2661.sZh: 我们提出了一种通过对抗过程估计生成模型的新框架，其中同时训练生成模型和判别模型，生成器的目标是欺骗判别器。

tsungyilin-1405.0312.sEn: A new dataset for object recognition in context, with 2.5M labeled instances across 91 object types.
tsungyilin-1405.0312.sZh: 一个用于上下文物体识别的新数据集，包含 91 种物体类型的 250 万个标注实例。

jbruna-1312.6203.sEn: We propose two generalizations of CNNs to signals on general domains: one via hierarchical clustering and another via graph Laplacian spectrum, enabling efficient deep architectures with input-size-independent parameters for low-dimensional graphs.
jbruna-1312.6203.sZh: 我们提出了两种将 CNN 推广到一般域上信号的方法：一种基于层次聚类，另一种基于图拉普拉斯谱，使得在低维图上能够学习到参数数量与输入大小无关的卷积层，从而实现高效的深度架构。

rgirshick-1311.2524.sEn: R-CNN combines region proposals with CNNs to achieve a 30% relative improvement in mAP on PASCAL VOC 2012.
rgirshick-1311.2524.sZh: R-CNN 将区域提议与 CNN 结合，在 PASCAL VOC 2012 上实现了 mAP 相对提升 30%。

tmikolov-1310.4546.sEn: We extend the Skip-gram model with subsampling and negative sampling to learn high-quality word and phrase vectors efficiently.
tmikolov-1310.4546.sZh: 我们通过子采样和负采样扩展了 Skip-gram 模型，高效地学习高质量的词和短语向量。

jeffdean-1301.3781.sEn: Proposed two novel model architectures for computing continuous word vectors from large datasets, achieving higher accuracy with lower computational cost.
jeffdean-1301.3781.sZh: 提出了两种新的模型架构，用于从大规模数据集中计算连续词向量，在降低计算成本的同时提高了准确性。

ilya-alexnet-2012.sEn: A deep CNN with 60M parameters achieved state-of-the-art results on ImageNet, using non-saturating neurons, efficient GPU implementation, and dropout to reduce overfitting.
ilya-alexnet-2012.sZh: 一个具有 6000 万参数的深度 CNN 在 ImageNet 上取得了最优结果，采用非饱和神经元、高效 GPU 实现和 dropout 减少过拟合。

hinton-1207.0580.sEn: Randomly omitting half of the feature detectors during training prevents co-adaptation and reduces overfitting, leading to significant improvements in neural network performance.
hinton-1207.0580.sZh: 在训练过程中随机丢弃一半的特征检测器可以防止共适应并减少过拟合，从而显著提升神经网络性能。

hinton-deep-belief-nets-2006.sEn: The paper presents a fast learning algorithm for Deep Belief Networks.
hinton-deep-belief-nets-2006.sZh: 本文提出了一种用于深度信念网络的快速学习算法。

shochreiter-lstm-1997.sEn: LSTM learns to bridge long time lags by enforcing constant error flow through constant error carousels, solving complex tasks that previous recurrent networks could not.
shochreiter-lstm-1997.sZh: LSTM 通过恒定误差流桥接长时间延迟，解决了以往循环网络无法解决的复杂任务。

hinton-backprop-1986.sEn: Error propagation enables learning in multi-layer networks with hidden units.
hinton-backprop-1986.sZh: 误差传播使得具有隐藏单元的多层网络能够学习。

hinton-boltzmann-machine-1985.sEn: A parallel search method based on statistical mechanics leads to a learning rule for modifying connection strengths in Boltzmann machines.
hinton-boltzmann-machine-1985.sZh: 基于统计力学的并行搜索方法导出了玻尔兹曼机中连接强度的学习规则。

hopfield-hopfield-1982.sEn: Neural networks and physical systems can exhibit useful computational abilities through collective behavior of many simple components.
hopfield-hopfield-1982.sZh: 神经网络和物理系统通过大量简单组件的集体行为涌现出有用的计算能力。

rosenblatt-perceptron-1958.sEn: This paper addresses the fundamental questions of how information is stored and how stored information influences recognition in the brain, proposing the perceptron as a probabilistic model.
rosenblatt-perceptron-1958.sZh: 本文探讨信息如何存储以及存储信息如何影响大脑中的识别，提出了感知器作为概率模型。

mcculloch-mcculloch-pitts-1943.sEn: Neural events and their relations can be treated with propositional logic due to the all-or-none character of nervous activity.
mcculloch-mcculloch-pitts-1943.sZh: 由于神经活动的全或无特性，神经事件及其关系可以用命题逻辑来处理。

simonwillison-ten-advances-in-mathematic.sEn: OpenAI's internal model Astra solved ten long-standing math problems at under $2,000 each, showcasing AI's potential in research.
simonwillison-ten-advances-in-mathematic.sZh: OpenAI 的内部模型 Astra 以每个问题不到 2000 美元的成本解决了十个长期未解的数学难题，展示了 AI 在科研中的潜力。

sebastianraschka-controlling-reasoning-e.sEn: A new GPT-5.6 model family offers multiple reasoning-effort settings, allowing users to control the trade-off between performance and computational cost.
sebastianraschka-controlling-reasoning-e.sZh: 新的 GPT-5.6 模型系列提供多种推理努力设置，使用户能够控制性能与计算成本之间的权衡。

sebastianraschka-inkling-architecture-no.sEn: Inkling is a 975B-parameter open-weight MoE model with 41B active parameters and 1M context, featuring short convolutions and learned relative-position bias instead of RoPE.
sebastianraschka-inkling-architecture-no.sZh: Inkling 是一款 975B 参数开放权重 MoE 模型，激活参数 41B，上下文 1M，采用短卷积和可学习相对位置偏置替代 RoPE。

sebastianraschka-gpt-5-6-configurations.sEn: GPT 5.6's 72 configurations map onto training-time and inference-time scaling, with Sol, Terra, Luna as model sizes and effort as inference compute.
sebastianraschka-gpt-5-6-configurations.sZh: GPT 5.6 的 72 种配置可映射到训练时和推理时扩展，其中 Sol、Terra、Luna 代表模型规模，effort 代表推理计算。

simonwillison-open-letters-ai-developmen.sEn: Open letters on AI development reflect industry pushback against potential US restrictions on open-weight models, citing innovation and safety concerns.
simonwillison-open-letters-ai-developmen.sZh: 关于 AI 发展的公开信反映了业界对美国可能限制开放权重模型的反对，强调创新与安全考量。

thinkingmachines-inkling.sEn: We release Inkling, a 975B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with open weights, supporting 1M context and native multimodal reasoning.
thinkingmachines-inkling.sZh: 我们发布了 Inkling，一个 975B 参数的混合专家模型，开放权重，支持 1M 上下文和原生多模态推理。
